title: Executive Headhunter
description:
At BairesDev®, we've been leading the way in technology projects for over 15 years. We deliver cutting-edge solutions to giants like Google and the most innovative startups in Silicon Valley.


Our diverse 4,000+ team, composed of the world's Top 1% of tech talent, works remotely on roles that drive significant impact worldwide.


When you apply for this position, you're taking the first step in a process that goes beyond the ordinary. We aim to align your passions and skills with our vacancies, setting you on a path to exceptional career development and success.


Talent Acquisition Senior Auditor at BairesDev


As a Senior Auditor , you'll play a key role in ensuring the quality, consistency, and reliability of recruitment audits. You'll handle complex and high-impact cases, review and guide junior auditors, and help align evaluation criteria across the team. This role offers the chance to make a real impact by improving the quality of hiring processes, working on meaningful and complex cases, shaping audit standards, and helping both processes and people grow through clear feedback and continuous improvement.


What You'll Do:


- Execute complex, sensitive, and high-impact audits.

- Supervise and review Junior Auditors' evaluations.

- Lead calibration calls and standardize criteria across the audit team.


What we are looking for:


- 5+ years of experience in Quality Assurance roles.

- Proven experience auditing complex and high-impact roles, including senior profiles, closers, and specialized positions.

- Hands-on experience supervising and calibrating Junior Auditors to ensure consistency and accuracy across evaluations.

- Advanced proficiency in English.


Nice to have:


- Experience in Talent Acquisition.

- Experience working with high-volume recruitment processes.

- Experience in data analysis and SQL.


How we do make your work (and your life) easier:


- 100% remote work (from anywhere).

- Excellent compensation in USD or your local currency if preferred

- Hardware and software setup for you to work from home.

- Flexible hours: create your own schedule.

- Paid parental leaves, vacations, and national holidays.

- Innovative and multicultural work environment: collaborate and learn from the global Top 1% of talent.

- Supportive environment with mentorship, promotions, skill development, and diverse growth opportunities.


Apply now and become part of a global team where your unique talents can truly thrive!

title: Consultor SAP BTP
description:
A Softtek está em busca de um(a) Consultor ABAP - BTP para fazer parte do nosso time e atuar em projetos desafiadores e de grande relevância!


Responsabilidades:

  • Avaliar o uso atual da SAP BTP no landscape e identificar impactos do upgrade do S/4HANA 2025 sobre integrações e extensões existentes.
  • Apoiar a definição e implementação de estratégias de extensibilidade sidebyside, alinhadas ao conceito de Clean Core SAP.
  • Atuar na revisão, adaptação ou criação de integrações utilizando SAP Integration Suite (ex.: CPI).
  • Garantir compatibilidade entre o S/4HANA upgrade e aplicações desenvolvidas em CAP, Fiori, APIs, eventos e serviços BTP.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times SAP (funcional, ABAP, Basis) e com o gerente de projeto para gerenciar dependências técnicas.
  • Apoiar a governança técnica das soluções BTP em um cenário com múltiplos projetos simultâneos.
  • Orientar decisões arquiteturais para reduzir customizações no core e viabilizar futuras evoluções do ERP.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada como Consultor SAP BTP, atuando com S/4HANA.
  • Vivência em projetos de upgrade SAP, preferencialmente com impactos em integrações ou extensibilidade.
  • Conhecimento das boas práticas SAP para Clean Core e extensibility strategy.
  • Experiência com pelo menos um dos componentes da BTP:
  • SAP Integration Suite (CPI)
  • SAP Extension Suite
  • SAP Event Mesh / APIs
  • Capacidade de atuação partime, com boa organização e foco em entregas.


Tipo de Alocação: 100% remoto

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Somos uma plataforma que ajuda investidores a encontrarem as melhores oportunidades de investimentos. Temos como base a filosofia Buy And Hold (Investimento de longo prazo). Trazemos para nossos usuários informações como: cotações, balanços, comparadores, históricos financeiros das empresas, gráficos, cursos, gerenciador de carteiras, entre outras funcionalidades. Lançada em dezembro de 2020, a plataforma vem tendo um ótimo crescimento, mensalmente já são mais de 18 milhões de pageviews acessadas.

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Product Designer Sênior com conhecimento em UX e foco em UI para elevar a experiência visual dos nossos produtos digitais. Você será responsável por transformar ideias em interfaces funcionais, consistentes e visualmente impecáveis — garantindo que design e negócio caminhem juntos. Procuramos alguém com olhar estético apurado, pensamento sistêmico e domínio técnico em design de interface, que entenda profundamente de sistemas de design, usabilidade e consistência visual em escala.


Escopo de atividades:


  • Desenhar interfaces digitais completas (web e mobile) com atenção a detalhes, consistência e acessibilidade.
  • Traduzir fluxos e requisitos de produto em soluções visuais escaláveis, dentro do design system.
  • Criar e evoluir componentes, padrões visuais e guidelines em colaboração com a área de Produto e de Tecnologia.
  • Garantir a qualidade visual e coerência entre plataformas (web, iOS, Android).
  • Trabalhar lado a lado com Product Managers e Engineers desde a concepção até a entrega.
  • Colaborar com a gestão com relação: wireframes e protótipos, adicionando clareza, hierarquia e emoção visual.
  • Participar de rituais de produto e trazer um olhar das boas práticas de design centrado no usuário.
  • Monitorar tendências de UI, motion e design systems para manter o produto atualizado e competitivo.


Requisitos Técnicos:


  • Experiência em Product Design ou UI Design em empresas digitais, startups ou scale-ups.
  • Portfólio sólido com interfaces de alta qualidade, demonstrando domínio de layout, tipografia, cor, hierarquia visual e pixel-perfect.
  • Domínio de ferramentas como Figma (componentes, auto layout, prototyping, variables).
  • Experiência prática em design systems e bibliotecas compartilhadas.
  • Familiaridade com guidelines de plataformas (Material Design, Human Interface Guidelines).
  • Entendimento de boas práticas de front-end (HTML, CSS, responsividade) para colaborar com devs.
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado.


Diferenciais:


  • Olhar crítico e alto padrão estético — “good taste + usability sense”.
  • Comunicação clara e empática com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Mentalidade de produto: entende métricas, trade-offs e impacto de design no negócio.
  • Organização e ownership: cuida do design system e documenta decisões.
  • Curiosidade e atualização constante sobre tendências visuais, tipografia e acessibilidade.
  • Perfil: resiliente, colaborativo e resolutivo.
  • Ser investidor e/ou conhecer o mercado de investimentos. 


Informações Complementares:


  • Ambiente de trabalho agradável e organizado;
  • Trabalho 100% Remoto;
  • Horário flexível;


Salário: a combinar


  • Contrato: Prestador de Serviços (PJ) com pacote completo de benefícios.

  • Desenhar interfaces digitais completas (web e mobile) com atenção a detalhes, consistência e acessibilidade.
  • Traduzir fluxos e requisitos de produto em soluções visuais escaláveis, dentro do design system.
  • Criar e evoluir componentes, padrões visuais e guidelines em colaboração com a área de Produto e de Tecnologia.
  • Garantir a qualidade visual e coerência entre plataformas (web, iOS, Android).
  • Trabalhar lado a lado com Product Managers e Engineers desde a concepção até a entrega.
  • Colaborar com a gestão com relação: wireframes e protótipos, adicionando clareza, hierarquia e emoção visual.
  • Participar de rituais de produto e trazer um olhar das boas práticas de design centrado no usuário.
  • Monitorar tendências de UI, motion e design systems para manter o produto atualizado e competitivo.


Requisitos Técnicos:


  • Experiência em Product Design ou UI Design em empresas digitais, startups ou scale-ups.
  • Portfólio sólido com interfaces de alta qualidade, demonstrando domínio de layout, tipografia, cor, hierarquia visual e pixel-perfect.
  • Domínio de ferramentas como Figma (componentes, auto layout, prototyping, variables).
  • Experiência prática em design systems e bibliotecas compartilhadas.
  • Familiaridade com guidelines de plataformas (Material Design, Human Interface Guidelines).
  • Entendimento de boas práticas de front-end (HTML, CSS, responsividade) para colaborar com devs.
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado.


Diferenciais:


  • Olhar crítico e alto padrão estético — “good taste + usability sense”.
  • Comunicação clara e empática com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Mentalidade de produto: entende métricas, trade-offs e impacto de design no negócio.
  • Organização e ownership: cuida do design system e documenta decisões.
  • Curiosidade e atualização constante sobre tendências visuais, tipografia e acessibilidade.
  • Perfil: resiliente, colaborativo e resolutivo.
  • Ser investidor e/ou conhecer o mercado de investimentos. 


Informações Complementares:


  • Ambiente de trabalho agradável e organizado;
  • Trabalho 100% Remoto;
  • Horário flexível;


Salário: a combinar


  • Contrato: Prestador de Serviços (PJ) com pacote completo de benefícios.

title: Emerging Market Trader
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.



Key Responsibilities

FX Trading & Liquidity Management

  • Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
  • Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
  • Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
  • Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.


Hedging Strategy & Risk Management

  • Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
  • Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
  • Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization .
  • Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.


Trading Infrastructure & Systems

  • Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including:
  • Automated hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation systems
  • Smart order routing
  • Pricing and risk management tools
  • Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
  • Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .


Market Development

  • Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
  • Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.



Requirements

Experience

  • 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
  • Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies , such as:
  • Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
  • LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
  • Experience working at:
  • Global banks
  • EM FX trading firms
  • Payment / fintech companies
  • Crypto exchanges or market makers
  • Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .


Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of:
  • FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
  • NDF markets and offshore hedging
  • Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
  • Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
  • FX trading systems
  • Hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation platforms
  • Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .


Skills

  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments .
  • Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks .
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations .
  • Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources .
  • Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies .
  • Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations .
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments



Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

description:

  • Familiaridade com sistemas de gestão (ERP) e Pacote Office;
  • Conhecimento em análise de indicadores de varejo;
  • Domínio de técnicas de vendas e negociação;
  • Flexibilidade de horário.

title: Legal Writer
description:
U.S. Immigration Law Firm, Law offices of Jacob J Sapochnick is growing and developing law firm in the USA that specializes in business, employment, investment, and family immigration to the USA. The law firm is known for providing its best to the clients by offering creative and strategic legal solutions. We are looking for the new team member, legal writer, to join our team.


Responsibilities:


Legal Brief & Petition Drafting:

  • Preparing legal briefs , including personal statements, expert opinions, and supporting arguments .
  • Engaging in extensive drafting , developing persuasive and well-structured arguments tailored to each case.

Case Strategy & Implementation:

  • Collaborating with senior legal specialists and U.S. attorneys to understand and execute case strategy effectively.
  • Ensuring that all legal arguments align with case objectives and meet the highest professional standards.

Legal Research & Analysis:

  • Conducting in-depth legal research to identify relevant statutes, judicial decisions, and immigration regulations
  • Staying up to date with evolving immigration laws and policy changes to ensure compliance and accuracy.
  • Be creative in drafting – must have!!!

Document Review

  • Reviewing client-provided documentation , identifying missing materials
  • Ensuring petitions are fully prepared in advance for mid and final attorney reviews, facilitating timely submission.

Attorney Support & Quality Assurance:

  • Assisting attorneys in case preparation, including gathering supporting documents, drafting legal arguments, and compiling evidence .
  • Collaborating with team members to enhance the accuracy, clarity, and persuasiveness of all written materials .


Requirements:


·      Excellent grammar, spelling, and written English composition skills is a must.


·      B.A. Degree in Law or Political Sciences or English studies student or graduate.


·      Previous legal or immigration writing experience preferred.


·      Extraordinary research and creative writing skills in English.


·      High level of accuracy, attention to detail, and excellent proofreading skills.


·      Strong organizational skills; ability to work under pressure, work within competing deadlines, and prioritize workload effectively.


·      Strong technical aptitude, including the ability to quickly learn new applications.


  • Salary depending on experience from $ - $ .



Schedule:

  • 8-hour shift,
  • Monday to Friday
  • Remote work

description:

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Compensation: R$9,802.52 monthly (Full-Time Equivalent)


Position Overview

The BMP (Business Model and Pricing) Analytics team is seeking an experienced Data Analyst to support business performance management and strategic decision-making through advanced analytics.

  • Proven ability to collaborate in cross-functional environments
  • Fluency in English

  • Familiarity with advanced analytics (forecasting, statistical analysis, scenario modeling)

  • Knowledge of data pipelines, automation, or orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow)
  • Exposure to big data technologies (e.g., Spark, PySpark)
  • Experience working in a global, matrixed organization

title: Electrical Engineering Pod Lead - 72132
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Job Overview:

An Electrical Engineering Pod Lead responsible for managing a small team creating simulation-based design problems used to train and evaluate advanced AI models. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers , and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud skills to review and support the pod end-to-end.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Team Leadership
  • Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation.
  • Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads.
  • Technical Oversight
  • Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading,
  • Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues.
  • Problem Design (Individual Contribution)
  • Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain.
  • Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions.


Electrical Engineering Subdomains:

You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus:

  • Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation.
  • Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization.
  • RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design.
  • Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design.
  • Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting.


Required Qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline.
  • At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation.
  • At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role.
  • Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments.
  • Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs.
  • Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.g., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar).


Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks.
  • Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation.
  • Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems.


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form .
  • Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form . After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment , which must be completed within 24 hours . Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round .
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements .



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

title: Associate II, Pharmacovigilance - Brazil - Remote
description:
What the Associate II, Pharmacovigilance does at Worldwide


Responsible for the collection, processing, evaluation and reporting of incoming Serious Adverse Event (SAE) data according to applicable regulatory guidelines/requirements, Worldwide Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and project specific instructions. Serves as Lead PV Associate on moderate to large sized studies that are moderate to complex in scope of work with moderate support from senior staff.


What you will do


  • Author Safety Management Plan for assigned studies
  • Attend and present at Investigator Meetings
  • Review incoming SAE data for completeness and accuracy
  • Perform data entry in the Safety Database and/or complete applicable tracking of incoming safety information
  • Perform QC of SAEs processed by other PV Associates
  • Generate regulatory reports and perform safety submissions as needed


What you will bring to the role


  • Strong understanding of medical and scientific terminology, of the principles of clinical assessment of adverse drug events, of international regulations and of reporting requirements
  • Strong understanding of computer technology, and management of relational database systems, including extraction of data
  • Excellent organizational skills and ability to handle multiple competing priorities within tight timelines
  • Consistently demonstrates commitment, dependability, cooperation, adaptability and flexibility in executing daily tasks and responsibilities


Your experience


  • Minimum of 3 years of pharmacovigilance experience (pre-approval clinical trials)
  • Bachelor’s degree in science related field, nursing or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience
  • Computer literacy and strong working knowledge of MS Office applications (Excel, PowerPoint, Word)
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Excellent organization skills and attention to detail
  • Demonstrated ability to handle multiple competing priorities while adhering to applicable timelines
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize work effectively and work successfully in matrix team environment
  • Ability and willingness for potential limited travel (domestic and international) as needed (attend Investigator Meeting, project kick-off meeting and/or bid defense meeting)
  • Fluent in written and verbal English

title: Operador de Plataforma - Remoto
description:
Operador de Plataforma


Quem Somos

Somos uma plataforma de tecnologia em plena expansão. Detalhes sobre nosso segmento de atuação e informações institucionais específicas serão compartilhados exclusivamente com os candidatos selecionados para a primeira fase de entrevistas.


O que oferecemos

  • Salário fixo PJ a combinar
  • Trabalho 100% remoto
  • Ambiente e clima de trabalho agradável e colaborativo
  • Grandes oportunidades de crescimento


Título da Posição: Operador de Plataforma (iGaming)


Objetivo  

Atuar na linha de frente da operação diária, sendo o responsável direto pelo monitoramento em tempo real, integridade dos mercados e coordenação ágil de respostas a incidentes para garantir uma experiência de jogo ininterrupta.


Responsabilidades

  • Monitorar a plataforma em tempo real, identificando anomalias em mercados, odds e comportamentos suspeitos.
  • Analisar relatórios transacionais, de gameplay e performance em sistemas de back-office (diários, semanais e mensais).
  • Executar procedimentos de contingência em falhas de feeds ou gateways de pagamento, realizando a escalada técnica necessária.
  • Garantir o compliance (KYC, AML e Jogo Responsável) através de ferramentas de autoexclusão e limites.
  • Atuar como interface estratégica entre as equipes de Tech, Produto, Marketing e Financeiro.


Requisitos

Obrigatórios

  • Experiência prévia em operações de plataformas de apostas (iGaming) ou ambientes de alto volume.
  • Domínio de mercados esportivos e estrutura de apostas (Pré-jogo e Ao vivo).
  • Disponibilidade total para escala 24/7 (incluindo noites, finais de semana e feriados).
  • Excel/Google Sheets intermediário para análises operacionais.
  • Possuir todos os equipamentos necessários (computador, internet estável, etc.) para atuação 100% remota.


Desejáveis

  • Experiência com plataformas B2B (Digitain, Betconstruct, Altenar, etc.).
  • Conhecimento em processos de pagamento (PIX) e regulamentação brasileira (Lei 14.790/2023).
  • Familiaridade com Jira e Inglês intermediário.


Comportamentais

  • Perfil analítico e alta capacidade de resolução de problemas sob pressão.
  • Excelente comunicação escrita para reporte e escalada de incidentes.


Etapas do Processo

  • Inscrição;
  • Triagem;
  • Entrevista RH;
  • Entrevista Gestor;
  • Offer;
  • Assinatura de Contrato.


INFORMAÇÃO IMPORTANTE: SÓ VAMOS CONSIDERAR E AVANÇAR COM PROFISSIONAIS QUE ATENDAM TODOS OS REQUISITOS BÁSICOS DA VAGA.


Se você tem o perfil dinâmico que buscamos e quer crescer em uma estrutura de alta performance, candidate-se agora ou compartilhe esta vaga com aquele contato que é referência no mercado!

title: Representante de atendimento ao cliente corporativo
description:
Procuramos um(a) BDR para atuar na prospecção ativa via ligações, e-mails e mensagens no WhatsApp, com foco em alimentar o funil de vendas e manter o CRM sempre atualizado.

Responsabilidades:

  • Realizar 100 a 150 tarefas diárias (ligações, envio de e-mails e mensagens no WhatsApp).
  • Prospecção de leads, qualificação de contatos e agendamento de reuniões para a equipe de vendas.
  • Preencher e atualizar o CRM com informações de contatos, atividades e status do funil.
  • Manter comunicação clara, cortês e profissional com os contatos.
  • Acompanhar métricas de desempenho e cumprir metas condicionais.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência prévia como BDR ou função semelhante é inconveniente.
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita.
  • Familiaridade com CRM e ferramentas de automação/comunicação.
  • Organização, disciplina e foco em resultados.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar conforme necessidade da empresa (horário a combinar).

Remuneração:

  • Fixo de R$ 1.000,00 (mensal).
  • Comissão adversa sobre resultados (detalhes a combinação). Favor esclarecer como é calculado e o regime de trabalho (presencial/ remoto).

Benefícios:

  • Oportunidade de desenvolvimento na área de vendas.
  • Treinamento inicial e acompanhamento de desempenho.

Como se™:

  • Envie mensagem pelo WhatsApp: com seu currículo e uma breve apresentação

title: Senior Python Developer
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


Step into the world of advanced software engineering as our Senior Python Developer, where you'll architect sophisticated solutions for global clients. This isn't just about coding, it's about leading technical initiatives, mentoring rising talent, and solving complex challenges using Python's powerful ecosystem while driving innovation in cloud environments, data processing, and web development.


Key responsibilities:


- Create automation systems and tools to configure, monitor, and orchestrate data infrastructure and pipelines.

- Develop data integration services that accelerate customer onboarding processes.

- Ensure reliability, performance, and support of data infrastructure with solutions aligned to application needs and growth projections.

- Lead the design and implementation of complex Python applications.

- Guide junior developers through comprehensive code reviews and technical mentoring.

- Architect scalable solutions using modern design patterns and industry best practices.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to transform business requirements into technical specifications.


Requirements:


- 5+ years of hands-on experience in Python and Django development.

- Experience with SQL and NoSQL Databases.

- Experience with Microservices and Cloud environments.

- Advanced algorithm knowledge.

- Intermediate agile methodologies management.

- Strong understanding of best practices, SOLID principles, CLEAN Code, and scalable solutions.

- Design Patterns knowledge.

- Experience developing entire applications from scratch.

- Experience in automated tests, CI/CD pipelines.

- Strong experience with version control.

- Strong experience with Unit testing, integration testing, and code coverage.

- Advanced English proficiency.


Benefits:

- Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

- Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

- Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

- Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

- Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

- Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

- Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

- Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Software Engineer III
description:
Top 3 habilidades técnicas obrigatórias: Desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful e microsserviços, frameworks JavaScript e banco de dados SQL/Postgres


Visão geral da posição

Como Engenheiro(a) de Software Principal na equipe de Administração de Membros dentro das soluções de Arquitetura, Engenharia e Construção da Autodesk, você será responsável por orientar a equipe de engenharia e liderar o design técnico para construir funcionalidades que preparem nossos clientes para o sucesso no Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC).

A equipe de Administração de Membros é responsável por fornecer aos clientes do ACC ferramentas para gerenciar usuários e permissões de hubs e projetos. Trabalhamos diretamente com nossos clientes para oferecer soluções para alguns de seus maiores desafios em gestão de construção. Você desempenhará um papel crítico em transformar essas soluções em realidade.

O ACC melhora a gestão da construção e capacita todos os construtores com equipes conectadas, fluxos de trabalho e dados por meio de uma plataforma onde os usuários podem interagir de forma fluida e eficiente ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida da construção. Nosso objetivo é economizar tempo eliminando redundâncias e oferecendo uma única plataforma que equipes inteiras podem usar para compartilhar informações de forma eficaz. Estamos construindo o futuro do software de construção.


Responsabilidades

  • Projetar, codificar, testar, depurar e documentar novas e existentes funcionalidades para garantir que a aplicação atenda às necessidades de negócio, qualidade e operação
  • Construir código robusto e de alta qualidade e estabelecer/manter altos padrões de qualidade e testes
  • Orientar membros da equipe sobre boas práticas de desenvolvimento de software
  • Interpretar e traduzir necessidades de negócio em requisitos técnicos e tarefas
  • Aplicar habilidades de resolução de problemas técnicos para projetar soluções de arquitetura seguras e escaláveis
  • Pesquisar e impulsionar a adoção de novas tecnologias
  • Identificar riscos e propor estratégias de mitigação relacionadas à arquitetura da aplicação
  • Participar ativamente de revisões de código e pull requests
  • Colaborar com diversas equipes dentro da ACS, tanto locais quanto internacionais
  • Atender, em regime de rodízio, incidentes críticos fora do horário comercial ou nos fins de semana para garantir disponibilidade 24/7 da plataforma


Qualificações mínimas

  • Mais de 8 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software e tecnologias web
  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência em produção com aplicações em infraestrutura de nuvem em larga escala
  • Experiência avançada na construção de APIs RESTful, microsserviços e interfaces front-end
  • Experiência avançada com frameworks JavaScript (Node.js, React)
  • Experiência avançada com SQL/Postgres
  • Forte conhecimento em AWS e arquiteturas em nuvem
  • Experiência sólida com ferramentas de manutenção e monitoramento de aplicações
  • Experiência sólida na criação de automações e pipelines de CI/CD
  • Experiência liderando uma equipe de pelo menos 3 engenheiros de software
  • Familiaridade com Docker para criação de aplicações containerizadas
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de se comunicar com diferentes públicos, incluindo gerentes de produto, clientes e engenheiros de software
  • Curiosidade para entender e analisar problemas, pensar criticamente e propor soluções
  • Habilidade de colaboração remota em equipes distribuídas
  • Flexibilidade diante de mudanças e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplos projetos
  • Paixão por crescimento, aprendizado e mentoria


Software de gestão de construção que serve como sua única fonte de verdade para cada projeto.

Saiba como o Autodesk Construction Cloud pode ajudar suas equipes a colaborar com segurança e rapidez em todas as fases do projeto, permitindo entregas dentro do prazo e do orçamento.

title: Technical Recruiter
description:
We are looking for a remote Technical Recruiter based in Latin America with 2 to 5 years of experience and excellent English skills, who has a keen eye for detail and a knack for finding ways to get it done.


We are a growth-stage company that works fast and smart. We want ambitious people who want to grow their skills. At Velozient, you will feel your contribution daily to the success of the team! We are not a huge company where you will get lost in the mix or stuck in a role.


Responsibilities

  • Take ownership of the Talent Pipeline and candidate engagement.
  • Conduct 1:1 interviews with qualified candidates.
  • Continuously assess and improve the recruitment process for efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Screen all the candidates and evaluate their fit for the opening.
  • Implement best practices to streamline workflows and enhance the overall recruitment experience.
  • Proactively conduct the full life cycle of identifying, engaging, and evaluating top candidates.
  • Collaborate with internal Resource Managers to ensure Velozient meets and exceeds client hiring goals, budgets, and performance standards.
  • Assure accurate/timely issuance of offer letters and clean/effective transition of candidates to the onboarding team.


KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, & EXPERIENCE

REQUIRED (Must Have):

  • Fluent in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Minimum of 3 to 5 years of experience in Recruiting, with at least two years in Technical Recruitment.
  • Proficiency in using social media platforms for networking purposes.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced team environment.
  • Familiarity with ApplicantTracking Systems and other recruitment tools is a plus.


Preferred (But not required):

  • University degree
  • Prior work for another North American-based company
  • Prior experience in a fast-paced, growth-stage, entrepreneurial company


What YOU Get!

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company and work with innovative and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - Think big!
  • Making mistakes is human - let’s learn from them -be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), designated national holidays, three sick leave days, and one floating day annually

title: Engenheiro (a) de Automação Sênior - Remoto
description:
We are looking for a hands‑on Automation Engineer ,who will design and build process automations across Azure, AWS, and Cortex XSOAR.


Unlike typical SOC automation roles, this position focuses on process and workflow automation, data orchestration, and cross‑platform integrations.


This job profile is for a senior Automation Engineer, focused on process automation and multi-cloud orchestration, much closer to automation


Experience with Agentic AI, LLM‑assisted automation patterns, or orchestration using AI-driven decision logic is considered a plus.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Design, build, and deploy cloud-native automation workflows, including:


  • Azure: Functions, Logic Apps


  • AWS: Glue Jobs, Lambda, Step Functions, S3


  • Develop and maintain Cortex XSOAR playbooks, integrations, Python scripts, and automation modules tailored to process automation scenarios.


  • Create cross-platform orchestration pipelines (e.g., XSOAR → Azure → AWS) to support data flows, enrichment, and workflow execution.


  • Build reusable automation templates and components for repeatability and rapid iteration.


  • Implement automation CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline, etc.).


  • Ensure all automations adhere to ISRM quality standards, security requirements, and best practices.


  • Conduct testing, validation, and documentation of automation workflows.


  • Collaborate in Agile ceremonies and contribute to continuous improvement of the automation capability.


Required Qualifications:


  • Strong hands-on engineering experience with Azure and AWS automation services.


  • Practical experience building solutions using Cortex XSOAR (playbooks, integrations, Python automations).


  • Solid understanding of process automation, event-driven architecture, and cloud orchestration patterns.


  • Experience working with APIs, data transformation, and multi-system integrations.


  • Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code and deployment automation practices.


  • Ability to work in Agile teams and communicate effectively with process owners and technical teams.


  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to translate process requirements into technical solutions.



Preferred Skills:


  • Knowledge of Agentic AI, LLM-driven automation, or autonomous workflow orchestration.


  • Experience integrating with enterprise systems such as ServiceNow, identity platforms, or data services.


  • Experience designing modular and configuration-driven automation frameworks

description:
Somos protagonistas na transformação digital dos meios de pagamento, somos a HST!

title: Global Networks Leader
description:
Purpose


As the Global Network Operations Leader, you will oversee the comprehensive management and direction of our network operations, ensuring optimal performance and reliability on a global scale. This critical role involves managing a managed service partner to deliver superior network operations and support services.


Main Responsibilities


Oversee the day-to-day network operations, including monitoring, maintenance, and incident response, to ensure high availability and performance.


Oversee the escalation process, ensuring timely resolution of critical network issues and minimizing impact on business operations.


Supervise routine maintenance activities, ensuring they are conducted efficiently and effectively to prevent unplanned downtime and extend the life of network assets.


Lead change management processes for network operations, including planning, approval, and implementation of network changes to ensure minimal disruption and adherence to best practices.


Act as the primary liaison with our managed service partner, ensuring they meet or exceed service level agreements (SLAs) and key performance indicators (KPIs).


Continuously assess and improve network performance, reliability, and security, leveraging data and analytics to drive decision-making.


Innovation and Improvement: Identify opportunities for process improvements and technology enhancements, leading initiatives to implement innovative solutions.


Develop and implement risk management strategies to mitigate potential network disruptions and ensure business continuity.


Communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders, providing regular updates on network performance, issues, and improvements.


Ensure compliance with relevant Orbia infrastructure standards, regulations, and security protocols to protect the organization's network infrastructure. Take care of regular audits.


Knowledge and experience requiered


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field
  • Language(s) and level of proficiency: English (fluent) and Spanish
  • In-depth knowledge of network infrastructure technologies, including routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, and network monitoring tools.
  • Proficiency in network protocols, such as TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, BGP, OSPF, and MPLS.
  • Experience with network security best practices and technologies, including VPNs, IDS/IPS, and network access control.
  • Familiarity with cloud networking and hybrid cloud environments, including AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform.
  • Experience with deploying, configuring, and testing network equipment.
  • Familiarity with automation tools and scripting (e.g., Ansible, Python).


Management & communication Skills


  • Experience in managing relationships with MSP, vendors and suppliers.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with internal stakeholders (e.g., operations, finance, senior management).


Relevant Experience


  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in network operations management, with at least 5 years in a leadership role overseeing global network operations.
  • Extensive experience working with and managing relationships with managed service partners.
  • Relevant certifications such as CCNP, CCIE, or equivalent are highly desirable.
  • ITIL certification is a plus.

  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in network operations management, with at least 5 years in a leadership role overseeing global network operations.

title: Product Designer
description:
At Avenue Code, we are passionate about transforming businesses through technology. We are a leading end-to-end development consultancy for digital transformation across various markets, growing sustainably since day one. We believe that great results are born from strong relationships. Our team combines technical expertise, collaboration, and a welcoming approach to work that makes all the difference.


About The Opportunity


We are looking for a Product Designer to join a fast-paced, product-driven environment focused on building innovative digital experiences in the data and financial technology space.

In this role, you will design end-to-end product experiences for a platform that redefines how users interact with and manage their data. You will work on complex, first-of-their-kind solutions, translating concepts such as data ownership, privacy, and monetization into intuitive, user-friendly interfaces for both consumers and businesses.


Responsibilities


  • Own the end-to-end design process, from discovery and research to delivery and developer handoff.
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and validation to inform design decisions.
  • Translate complex concepts into clear, intuitive, and accessible user experiences.
  • Collaborate closely with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to align vision and execution.
  • Create and iterate on wireframes, prototypes, and user flows based on feedback and data.
  • Contribute to and maintain a Design System across web and mobile platforms.
  • Ensure consistency, usability, and high-quality visual design across all touchpoints.
  • Support the creation of marketing and web assets aligned with brand guidelines.


Required Qualifications


  • Strong experience in Product Design with a portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product work.
  • Proficiency in Figma for design, prototyping, and developer handoff.
  • Ability to simplify complex systems and concepts into intuitive user experiences.
  • Hands-on experience with user research, discovery, and validation methods.
  • Experience building and evolving Design Systems in collaboration with engineering teams.
  • Ability to work independently in high-ambiguity, fast-paced environments.
  • Strong collaboration skills and a user-centered mindset.
  • Experience using tools such as user journey mapping, flow diagrams, and prototyping techniques.
  • Understanding of different levels of design fidelity, from low-fidelity concepts to production-ready designs.
  • Advanced to Fluent level of English (mandatory).


Nice To Have Skills


  • Experience with Webflow or Framer for marketing or institutional websites.
  • Background in AI, privacy, or data-related products.
  • Experience designing native mobile applications (iOS and Android).
  • Experience working on products in early-stage or product-market fit environments.


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Tech Lead
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu porcesso de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.


Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho:

- Liderar a parte técnica do time, atuando de forma prática no desenvolvimento;

- Definir, organizar e priorizar as user stories, além de gerenciar o board no Jira;

- Realizar code reviews, orientar os desenvolvedores e assegurar boas práticas de codificação;

- Interagir diretamente com o stakeholder do cliente (Gabriel) para alinhamento de prioridades e requisitos;

- Criar e manter a documentação técnica no Confluence;

- Apoiar na resolução de bugs, otimização de performance e integração entre front-end e back-end;

- Promover melhoria contínua, colaboração e autonomia no time.


O que você precisa ter:

- Experiência sólida em .NET (C#) e SQL Server;

- Bom domínio de React e integração via APIs REST;

- Experiência anterior como Tech Lead ou Desenvolvedor Sênior em ambientes complexos ou legados;

- Experiência com GitHub (preferencialmente com GitHub Copilot), Jira e Confluence;

- Boa comunicação, proatividade e capacidade de liderança técnica;

- Inglês avançado;

- Desejável:

- Experiência prévia em sistemas financeiros, gestão de ativos ou ambientes corporativos complexos;

- Capacidade de definir padrões técnicos e processos para times autogerenciáveis.


Onde você vai trabalhar?

100% remoto.

title: English+Spanish speaking Inspector/Customer Support Representative
description:
Join our fast-growing company as an English+Spanish speaking Inspector/Customer Support Representative with C1 level of English language and C1 level of Spanish language.


It is a remote full-time position.


Schedule: The role does not follow a fixed schedule and may be

assigned to AM or PM shifts within Pacific Standard Time (PST). Example shift hours

may include 5:00 AM to 2:00 PM PST, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM PST, or 12:00 PM to 9:00

PM PST. The schedule will be communicated in advance and follows a 5x2 work

pattern.


Starting date: ASAP


At Mindy Support you have great opportunity to get:


  • Experience in the international company working with people around the globe;
  • Compensation : $650 during 3 months of probation; $650 (after trial period) + 50$ bonus for KPIs | A Loyalty Bonus is offered based on the achievement of KPIs and attendance requirements. The bonus increases over time in recognition of consistent performance, reliability, and tenure..
  • Training will be provided by the company and the client;
  • Dynamic work in a young team of like-minded people;
  • Management's attention, support and motivation.


The Vehicle Inspector role provides vehicle inspections for customers. Vehicle Inspectors will work in an online environment to provide vehicle inspections via video chat. Having live interaction with

ride share drivers, those with good customer service skills, ability to multitask and can

learn quickly will excel in the Vehicle Inspector role.

AREAS OF FOCUS

● Customer Service

● Vehicle Inspections

● Internal communication


RESPONSIBILITIES:


- Initiate video calls with drivers at their scheduled appointment time.

- Camera must remain on during all inspections with the company background

applied. Maintain a professional appearance; casual but neat attire is required.

- Explain the inspection process clearly and concisely.

- Answer basic questions related to the inspection or redirect to the appropriate team

when necessary.

- Verify the driver’s identity and confirm their inspection request.

- Guide the driver step-by-step in positioning their phone or camera to show the

necessary parts of the vehicle.

- Exterior and interior of the vehicle (including tires, lights, mirrors, seat belts, horn,

and other key points)

- Observe and assess the condition of each required inspection point to determine

whether the vehicle meets compliance standards.

- Communicate the pass/fail result to the driver and provide a brief explanation if the

vehicle fails.

- Record the inspection outcome (Pass, Fail, or No-Show) in the internal system

immediately after the appointment.


You are our perfect candidate if you are:


●A good communicator, excelent English speaking and writing;

●C1 level of Spanish language

●C1 level of English language

● Rideshare inspection knowledge a plus

● Able to multitask with attention to detail

● Customer service experience

● Good with technology

● Able to work alongside team members in an online environment

● Inspectors must have their own computer, smartphone and strong wifi service

●Are client-oriented and attentive to details, have active listening skills, problem solver, hard-

working, team-player.

●Self-employment. We will sign a contract with you as with independent businessman;

●You can work from home, don’t be distracted;


Mindy Support is a global company. We empower businesses all over the world through providing remote assistants and outsourced teams specialized in customer support, tech support, back office activities, and agile sales and marketing support.


We respect the individuality and culture of each member of our large team, and appreciate the contribution of each employee to support our Customers.


We will be glad to welcome you to our team. Grow your career with Mindy Support!

title: Strategic Partnership & Alliance
description:
About RateGain

RateGain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered SaaS solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. RateGain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.

Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today RateGain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.


Exploring the role

RateGain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, RateGain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.

The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.

This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.


How your day will look like/Job responsibility

  • Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)
  • Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with RateGain’s GTM strategy in LATAM
  • Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem
  • Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements
  • Represent RateGain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions
  • Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue
  • Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trends


Education & Work Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnerships


Knowledge:

  • In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystem
  • Knowledge of SaaS business models and partnership structures
  • Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectors


Skills:

  • Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities
  • Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills in Spanish, Portuguese, and English
  • Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities
  • Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools
  • Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)


Attitude:

  • Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation
  • Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team
  • High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership
  • Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

title: Senior Helpdesk Support Specialist
description:
Position Overview
As a senior member of our IT support team, you will provide advanced, second-level technical assistance to end-users, resolving complex issues related to computer hardware, software, and systems within a Windows-based environment. A significant component of this position involves coaching, mentoring, and providing technical guidance to Level 1 help desk technicians, contributing directly to the team's growth and the achievement of leadership goals. You will serve as a key escalation point, performing in-depth diagnostics, implementing solutions, and managing small IT projects. Key responsibilities include basic network connectivity triage for LAN, WAN, and wireless access points, asset management administration, and maintaining a comprehensive knowledge base to enable proactive problem resolution. This role requires performing basic Active Directory tasks, Microsoft 365 troubleshooting, and device management using Microsoft Intune, ensuring the daily performance and stability of our computer systems. Position title: Senior Helpdesk Support SpecialistLocation: Remote - LATAM
Key Responsibilities
  • Help supervise ticket flow in Jira, ensuring proper triage, routing, and escalation.
  • Mentor, coach, and provide technical guidance to Level 1 helpdesk technicians to support their professional development and ensure overall team success.
  • Serve as the primary escalation point for complex end-user IT issues, providing advanced second-level support for computer systems, hardware, and software.
  • Manage small-scale IT projects, overseeing tasks and special assignments to ensure successful completion and alignment with departmental objectives.
  • Proactively identify recurring technical problems, implementing permanent solutions and making recommendations for IT improvements to reduce incident volume.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues by installing, modifying, and repairing computer software, and peripherals on Windows operating systems.
  • Perform basic network triage for Local Area Networks (LAN), Wide Area Networks (WAN), and wireless access points to resolve initial connectivity issues before escalation.
  • Execute fundamental administrative tasks in Active Directory, such as account unlocks and password resets, and provide end-user troubleshooting for Microsoft 365 applications.
  • Utilize Microsoft Intune for key device management functions.
  • Administer the IT asset management system, ensuring accurate tracking and documentation of software assets.
  • Develop, preserve, and grow a comprehensive knowledge base of procedures and solutions for both internal help desk use and end-user self-help resources.
  • Strong documentation discipline and ability to follow and improve SOPs and knowledge base articles
  • Design and conduct training sessions for computer users to enhance their technical proficiency and understanding of IT systems.
  • Manage and progress tickets in Jira Service Management, including triage, updates, proper routing, and escalation.
  • Basic familiarity with endpoint security and antivirus concepts is helpful, issues are typically escalated to the appropriate security team.
Required Skills & Experience
  • Proven experience providing remote help desk and desktop support, including diagnosing, guiding, and resolving issues related to computer hardware, software, and peripherals through virtual and phone-based assistance.
  • Demonstrated leadership abilities, including experience providing technical guidance, coaching, and mentoring to junior help desk technicians.
  • Working knowledge of help desk software and remote control tools.
  • Experience working in Jira Service Management, or strong experience with similar ITSM ticketing systems and workflows.
  • Experience with basic Active Directory user management, such as password changes and account unlocks, and providing end-user troubleshooting for Microsoft 365.
  • Proficiency in resolving basic connectivity issues for Local Area Networks (LAN), Wide Area Networks (WAN), and wireless access points through basic triage.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to develop training materials and maintain a knowledge base.
  • Proven ability to manage small IT projects and perform asset management administration.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Intune for device enrollment.
Nice to Have Skills
  • Professional IT certifications, such as CompTIA A+, Network+, or Microsoft IT Support.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Intune for device enrollment via Windows Autopilot and performing machine resets.
  • Experience with PowerShell scripting to automate routine administrative tasks.
  • Knowledge of supporting additional operating systems, such as macOS, iOS, or Android.
  • Experience with advanced network troubleshooting using command-line tools.
Soft Skills
  • Demonstrated leadership capabilities, with a focus on coaching, mentoring, and providing technical guidance to junior team members to foster their growth and ensure overall team success.
  • Exceptional communication skills (verbal, written, and presentation), with the ability to convey complex technical solutions clearly to clients of varying proficiency levels and to conduct effective training sessions.
  • Advanced analytical and troubleshooting abilities, characterized by a proactive approach to not only resolve immediate issues but also to identify root causes and implement solutions that prevent future occurrences.
  • A strong client-centric mindset, demonstrating the ability to understand problems from the user's perspective and guide them through the resolution process with patience and clarity.
  • Proven ability to work effectively within a high-performing team environment, collaborating with colleagues and assisting other IT support teams to share knowledge and achieve common goals.
  • Excellent organizational and multitasking skills, including the ability to manage small IT projects, maintain meticulous attention to detail, and exercise sound judgment in tracking, routing, and escalating support tickets.
Why You Will Love Working with Us
Join a powerful tech workforce and help us change the world through technology Professional development opportunities with international customers Collaborative work environment Career path and mentorship programs that will lead to new levels. Join Lean Tech and contribute to shaping the data landscape within a dynamic and growing organization. Your skills will be honed, and your contributions will play a vital role in our continued success. Lean Tech is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusiveenvironment for all employees.

You will serve as a key escalation point, performing in-depth diagnostics, implementing solutions, and managing small IT projects. Key responsibilities include basic network connectivity triage for LAN, WAN, and wireless access points, asset management administration, and maintaining a comprehensive knowledge base to enable proactive problem resolution. Key Responsibilities
  • Help supervise ticket flow in Jira, ensuring proper triage, routing, and escalation.
  • Mentor, coach, and provide technical guidance to Level 1 helpdesk technicians to support their professional development and ensure overall team success.
  • Serve as the primary escalation point for complex end-user IT issues, providing advanced second-level support for computer systems, hardware, and software.
  • Manage small-scale IT projects, overseeing tasks and special assignments to ensure successful completion and alignment with departmental objectives.
  • Proactively identify recurring technical problems, implementing permanent solutions and making recommendations for IT improvements to reduce incident volume.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues by installing, modifying, and repairing computer software, and peripherals on Windows operating systems.
  • Perform basic network triage for Local Area Networks (LAN), Wide Area Networks (WAN), and wireless access points to resolve initial connectivity issues before escalation.
  • Execute fundamental administrative tasks in Active Directory, such as account unlocks and password resets, and provide end-user troubleshooting for Microsoft 365 applications.
  • Utilize Microsoft Intune for key device management functions.
  • Administer the IT asset management system, ensuring accurate tracking and documentation of software assets.
  • Develop, preserve, and grow a comprehensive knowledge base of procedures and solutions for both internal help desk use and end-user self-help resources.

  • Design and conduct training sessions for computer users to enhance their technical proficiency and understanding of IT systems.
  • Manage and progress tickets in Jira Service Management, including triage, updates, proper routing, and escalation.
  • Basic familiarity with endpoint security and antivirus concepts is helpful, issues are typically escalated to the appropriate security team.

  • Proven experience providing remote help desk and desktop support, including diagnosing, guiding, and resolving issues related to computer hardware, software, and peripherals through virtual and phone-based assistance.
  • Demonstrated leadership abilities, including experience providing technical guidance, coaching, and mentoring to junior help desk technicians.
  • Working knowledge of help desk software and remote control tools.
  • Experience working in Jira Service Management, or strong experience with similar ITSM ticketing systems and workflows.
  • Experience with basic Active Directory user management, such as password changes and account unlocks, and providing end-user troubleshooting for Microsoft 365.
  • Proficiency in resolving basic connectivity issues for Local Area Networks (LAN), Wide Area Networks (WAN), and wireless access points through basic triage.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to develop training materials and maintain a knowledge base.

title: Vendedor | Closer
description:
Closer de Vendas (High Ticket | Webinários)

Buscamos um Closer com mentalidade de dono, foco em resultado e alta capacidade de execução. Ambiente meritocrático, com alta exigência e ganhos proporcionais à performance.


Vaga PJ



Remuneração e Metas

Período de Experiência

  • Fixo: R$ 2.000
  • Meta: R$ 150.000
  • Ticket médio: R$ 35.000

→ 4 a 5 vendas batem a meta

→ 100% da meta dobra o fixo

→ Aceleradores progressivos para overperformance


Pós-Efetivação

  • Fixo: R$ 3.000 a R$3500,00
  • Meta: R$ 250.000



Estrutura Comercial

  • Leads qualificados + prospecção estratégica
  • Operação forte de social selling
  • 2 a 3 calls/dia
  • Conversão média esperada: ~30%

→ Potencial de 2 a 3 vendas por semana


Crescimento

  • 3 meses consecutivos batendo meta = promoção
  • Aumento de fixo + meta
  • Crescimento acelerado por mérito


Cultura

Alta performance, disciplina e cobrança.

Liberdade financeira é consequência da execução.


Perfil

  • Experiência como Closer (preferência: mercado digital)
  • Forte habilidade em fechamento e vendas consultivas
  • Alta competitividade e resiliência a metas agressivas
  • Autogestão e consistência


Diferenciais:

  • Vendas high ticket
  • Experiência com funis de webinário
