title: Data Business Analyst \"#999892\"
description:
Quem Somos

“A DEXIAN é uma consultoria global de origem Americana focada em talentos para complementar a equipe de tecnologia da informação de nossos clientes. Estamos presente em 10 países, com 45 escritórios ao redor do mundo. Por mais de 25 anos, a DEXIAN® atende indústrias e clientes globais, em diversas áreas, com a missão de atrair e reter os maiores talentos do mundo.

Hoje somos orgulhosamente reconhecidos como uma das maiores empresas de “staffing augmentation” dos Estados Unidos pela Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA). Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

No Brasil, chegamos em 2007 e de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia.


O que esperar de nós

É importante que você saiba que por trás de cada movimento DEXIAN existem cinco valores fundamentais: colaboração, respeito, justiça, comprometimento e engenhosidade. Colaboração, justiça e respeito não são apenas palavras; comprometimento não é só um pensamento; e engenhosidade vai além de aspiração. Essas qualidades nos definem em todos os níveis, todas as parcerias e na forma como trabalhamos todos os dias. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

A DEXIAN do Brasil incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.


Nosso Cliente

Essa vaga irá atender nosso cliente no segmento de engenharia de sistemas.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Business Analyst to join our team and report directly to the Director of Business Intelligence. This role is critical in supporting data-driven decision-making across the organization by delivering actionable insights, maintaining reporting frameworks, and ensuring the integrity and accessibility of business data. The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between business stakeholders and technical teams, translating data into meaningful strategies that drive performance.
  • Partner closely with the Director of Business Intelligence to support strategic initiatives and data-driven decision-making.
  • Analyze business performance data and deliver actionable insights to stakeholders across departments.
  • Develop, maintain, and enhance dashboards, scorecards, and recurring reports to track key performance indicators (KPIs).
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather business requirements and translate them into reporting and analytics solutions.
  • Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability across reporting platforms and data sources.
  • Assist in the design, development, and optimization of data models and data pipelines.
  • Support the creation of executive-level presentations and reporting materials.
  • Identify trends, risks, and opportunities through data analysis and communicate findings effectively.
  • Manage ad-hoc analysis requests and prioritize competing projects based on business impact.
  • Document business definitions, data logic, and reporting processes to ensure transparency and scalability.



O que você precisa ter:

  • Advenced english is primordial, you'll work with an international team.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 3–5+ years of experience in business analysis, data analytics, or a related role.
  • Must have experience in PowerBI and Snowflake
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and experience working with large datasets.
  • Experience with data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.
  • Understanding of data warehousing concepts and ETL/ELT processes.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams in a collaborative environment.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with a keen attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present complex data in a clear and concise manner.
  • Self-motivated with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Data analysis and interpretation
  • Business acumen
  • Stakeholder communication
  • Critical thinking and problem-solving
  • Organization and prioritization


Onde você vai trabalhar:

Regime remoto, qualquer lugar do Brasil.

title: AI Engineer Sênior - REMOTO
description:
Descrição da vaga

A Verity está buscando novos talentos!


Somos uma consultoria de transformação de inovação digital e buscamos IA Engineer Sênior para fazer parte dessa jornada.


Olha só quais são as experiências e conhecimentos que você precisa ter para acelerar e transformar com a gente:

Responsabilidades e atribuições

• Projetar, desenvolver e evoluir agentes e workflows utilizando arquiteturas baseadas em MCP

• Construir pipelines de RAG e mecanismos de recuperação de contexto com uso de bancos de dados vetoriais

• Integrar agentes com APIs, ferramentas e serviços externos para execução de fluxos complexos

• Desenvolver agentes em Python utilizando Google ADK

• Construir e manter fluxos agentivos com LangChain e LangGraph

• Integrar modelos e serviços de IA por meio de Vertex AI e modelos Gemini

• Implementar pipelines de build, testes e deploy para agentes e workflows

• Definir padrões de arquitetura, componentes reutilizáveis e diretrizes de governança técnica para a plataforma

• Garantir observabilidade das soluções por meio de logs, métricas e tracing

• Atuar em parceria com times técnicos para assegurar integração consistente entre agentes de IA e aplicações corporativas

• Projetar soluções alinhadas aos processos, integrações e objetivos do negócio

• Assegurar que os componentes desenvolvidos sejam escaláveis, reutilizáveis e preparados para evolução contínua

Requisitos e qualificações

• Experiência sólida com desenvolvimento em Python

• Vivência prática na construção de agentes, workflows inteligentes e integrações com modelos de IA generativa

• Experiência com LangChain e LangGraph

• Conhecimento em arquiteturas baseadas em MCP

• Experiência com pipelines de RAG e bancos de dados vetoriais

• Vivência com integração de APIs, ferramentas e serviços externos

• Experiência com Vertex AI e modelos Gemini

• Conhecimento em práticas de build, testes e deploy de aplicações

• Capacidade de definir padrões técnicos, abstrações reutilizáveis e boas práticas de engenharia

• Experiência com observabilidade, incluindo logs, métricas e tracing

• Capacidade de atuar de forma colaborativa com times de engenharia, arquitetura e squads técnicas

• Visão sistêmica para entender fluxos de dados, integrações e restrições de ambientes corporativos


Diferenciais:


• Experiência com plataformas corporativas de agentes de IA

• Vivência na definição de governança técnica para soluções baseadas em IA

• Conhecimento em arquiteturas escaláveis e orientadas à reutilização de componentes

• Experiência em ambientes corporativos complexos, com múltiplas integrações e restrições arquiteturais

• Atuação prévia em iniciativas de padronização técnica e evolução de frameworks internos

• Conhecimento em práticas de MLOps, avaliação de agentes e operação contínua de soluções de IA

Informações adicionais


Aqui nós somos humanos, somos digitais, somos Verity!


Tudo o que fazemos se baseia em nossos 8 POWER PRINCIPLES:

  • Amar tecnologia;
  • Assumir grandes responsabilidades;
  • Cultivar relações de confiança por meio da transparência;
  • Dar atenção e ser orientado pela necessidade e experiência do cliente;
  • Encarar desafios de forma ágil;
  • Colaborar entre pessoas e equipes;
  • Encorajar a autonomia consciente;
  • Atingir resultados de forma consciente.


É assim que criamos experiências inovadoras para o mundo digital, inspirando protagonismo e gerando resultados incríveis aos nossos clientes, sempre focados em metodologia, tecnologia e pessoas.


Fomos certificados como uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar pelo Great Place To Work, e a cada dia criamos ações que melhoram ainda mais o ambiente de trabalho, aqui na Verity você tem:

  • Vale refeição
  • Vale alimentação
  • Auxílio home office
  • Assistência médica
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Seguro de vida
  • Parcerias de descontos
  • Convênios em estabelecimentos e instituições de ensino
  • Treinamentos de agilidade recorrentes
  • Intervalo Verity
  • #VerityComVocê


E aí, topa criar experiências inovadoras para o mundo digital?


Etapas do processo

  • Etapa 1: Cadastro
  • Etapa 2: Entrevista RH
  • Etapa 3: Entrevista Tech
  • Etapa 4: Entrevista Final
  • Etapa 5: Processo de Contratação
  • Etapa 6: Contratação

Somos uma consultoria de Transformação e Engenharia Digital_

A Verity é uma consultoria de Transformação e Engenharia Digital.


Estruturamos tecnologia para funcionar, escalar e gerar valor real. Atuamos na Modernização de Aplicações, decisões críticas de Arquitetura, Engenharia de Software e Dados, Experiência Digital e orquestração de processos com Inteligência Artificial.


Com o Verity Quantum®, nosso orquestrador de IA, conectamos engenharia, plataformas e operações para modernizar legados, otimizar código e acelerar decisões com impacto direto no negócio.


Há 16 anos, trabalhamos ao lado de mais de 100 empresas líderes em seus mercados, nos setores financeiro, saúde, varejo, indústria e serviços, transformando estratégia em soluções tecnológicas que geram eficiência, escala e vantagem competitiva.


Desde 2019, somos certificados como Great Place to Work - GPTW, reconhecimento que reforça nossa cultura baseada em transparência, confiança e compromisso real com a entrega.

title: Salesforce Developer
description:
Company Description

We are a software startup dedicated to unifying ERP and CRM solutions into one seamless platform. As we prepare for growth, we are seeking an experienced Salesforce Developer that has hands-on experience, particularly with integrations and solution design and implementation.


Role Description

This is a full-time remote position for a Salesforce Developer. The Salesforce Developer will be responsible for designing, developing, and customizing Salesforce solutions, including creating and optimizing Visualforce Pages and Lightning Web Components. Responsibilities also include Salesforce.com administration, integration with other enterprise applications, troubleshooting, and maintaining scalable and secure solutions. Collaboration with cross-functional teams to meet business requirements is integral to this role. While remote, this role will be working during Eastern Standard Timezone (US) hours from 8am to 5pm.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and customize Salesforce applications using Lightning and Apex
  • Collaborate with functional teams to gather and analyze business requirements
  • Build scalable, secure, and high-performance solutions
  • Perform debugging, testing, and deployment activities
  • Provide ongoing support and enhancements to existing applications


Qualifications

  • In-depth understanding of Salesforce.com platform capabilities and customization
  • 2–5 years of hands-on experience in Salesforce development
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems or related field
  • Strong expertise in Salesforce Lightning (LWC/Aura)
  • Experience with Agentic AI or AI-based solutions is a plus
  • Solid understanding of Apex, Triggers, Workflows, SOQL/SOSL, and integrations
  • Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
  • Experience with Salesforce.com Administration tasks and configuration

title: Executive Administrative Assistant
description:
Instead of applying to one remote job, you could access a community where new remote opportunities become available every week.


At Virtual Latinos, we connect experienced professionals from Latin America with growing companies in the U.S., Canada, and beyond that are building distributed remote teams. Our community includes more than 5,000+ professionals hired and 2,500+ companies that rely on Virtual Latinos to find skilled remote talent.


Join a community where you'll learn, connect with like-minded professionals, and access real remote opportunities with top North American companies.


Highlight Role of the Week!


Executive Administrative Assistant (Remote)


About the role:


This opportunity is designed for experienced administrative professionals who are comfortable supporting leadership teams, coordinating business priorities, and ensuring operations run smoothly in fast-paced remote environments.


Pay Rates:


Part-time Monthly Rates: $800 to $1,280 (20 hours per week)


Full-time Monthly Rates: $1,600 to $2,560 (40 hours per week)


The posted monthly salary range is an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated based on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $10- $16, depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.


Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the position and client. Most schedules align with U.S. and Canadian business hours.


Key responsibilities:


  • Executive Calendar Management: Coordinate complex scheduling across multiple time zones and manage executive priorities.
  • Inbox & Communications: Oversee executive inbox communication, draft professional responses, and manage internal/external correspondence on behalf of leadership.
  • Project Coordination: Coordinate projects across teams while ensuring deadlines and milestones remain aligned.
  • Reporting: Prepare executive summaries, presentations, and operational reports.
  • CRM & Systems: Support CRM management and maintain accurate operational records across platforms.
  • Stakeholder Liaison: Act as a point of contact between executives, internal teams, clients, and vendors.
  • Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve administrative workflows and operational efficiency.


What you bring:


  • Must be 21+ years old
  • 3+ years of experience in administrative support, executive assistance, or operations coordination roles
  • Bilingual English (C1 or above) /Spanish
  • Experience supporting executives, founders, or leadership teams


Required:


  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities independently in remote environments
  • Proficient in Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Docs, Sheets, Drive) and/or Microsoft Office 365
  • Working knowledge of CRM platforms (HubSpot, Salesforce) and project management tools (Asana, ClickUp, Monday or similar)
  • Comfortable with Slack, Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Calendly, Canva, and AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude)


How the process works


  • Apply through LinkedIn Easy Apply.
  • Qualified candidates will receive instructions to complete their full application and join the Virtual Latinos community.
  • Once accepted, you will gain access to ongoing remote job opportunities with U.S. companies looking for experienced remote professionals.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
We are seeking a full-time, remote Senior Data Engineer with 5+ years of experience to join our U.S. client's software engineering team. This key individual should have experience making decisions, working on a small development team, and working both independently and as part of a small, dynamic team where everything you do makes a difference.

The industry-leading client provides business-automating, enterprise resource planning (ERP) accounting software for the oil & gas industry. The client's software and services streamline and automate complex processes, such as revenue distribution, billing, order management, production accounting, accounts payable, contract management, and more, for over 1,700 customers across 9 countries.

The senior-level position will be part of the client's Intelligence team. This business intelligence solution brings data from multiple products onto one platform, enabling analysis and data-driven insights. Responsibilities will focus on designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and infrastructure that converts raw data into a format ready for ingestion by a BI tool. The individual will coordinate with the implementation team to provide on-time deliverables, quality products, and exceptional customer service.


Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain scalable data pipelines that power clients' products, which support core product functionality, customer reporting, and internal analytics.
  • Take end‑to‑end ownership of data flows, from ingestion to delivery, with a focus on data quality and reliability.
  • Create and maintain production‑grade database views and transformation logic.
  • Develop, optimize, and manage SQL view scripts and transformations.
  • Design, configure, and maintain database architectures, distributed systems, and data storage solutions.
  • Ensure data integrity by implementing validation processes for data accuracy, consistency, and reliability.
  • Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and optimize data queries and workflows for efficiency.
  • Build and support data integrations with internal services and third‑party APIs, managing authentication, schema evolution, rate limits, and error handling. Proactively adapt pipelines as client products and customer needs grow.
  • Research and recommend innovative approaches for project execution. Recommend areas for improvement in internal processes along with possible solutions, providing status reports to stakeholders, and addressing issues as appropriate.
  • Participate with the team in problem resolution regarding systems and procedures. Assists the team or supervisor in identifying data anomalies and providing business solutions.
  • Document procedures using text, workflow diagrams, and screenshots from the application. Develops and maintains installations and configuration procedures. Provides documentation for institutional workflow processes associated with the application.


Required Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, Accounting, or related field
  • Excellent English verbal and written communication skills
  • 5+ years of data engineering experience
  • 3+ years SQL and Python experience
  • Knowledge of database architecture and management
  • Experience working with Cloud Platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP, etc.)
  • Ability to read code and convert programming logic from one language to another
  • Familiarity with APIs


Preferred Experience

  • Experience working with data analytics tools (e.g., Power BI, QuickSight, Looker, Sisense)
  • Experience with Apache Airflow
  • Experience with AI coding tools and/or AI assistants
  • Background in Math, Stats, Machine Learning


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

  • Ensure data integrity by implementing validation processes for data accuracy, consistency, and reliability.
  • Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and optimize data queries and workflows for efficiency.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, Accounting, or related field
  • Excellent English verbal and written communication skills
  • 5+ years of data engineering experience
  • 3+ years SQL and Python experience
  • Knowledge of database architecture and management
  • Experience working with Cloud Platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP, etc.)
  • Ability to read code and convert programming logic from one language to another
  • Familiarity with APIs


Preferred Experience

  • Experience working with data analytics tools (e.g., Power BI, QuickSight, Looker, Sisense)
  • Experience with Apache Airflow
  • Experience with AI coding tools and/or AI assistants
  • Background in Math, Stats, Machine Learning


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

description:
Full-Stack Developer (Ruby and React)

100% remote | PJ


>>> Only resumes in english <<<


We’re looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to join a high-impact project. You’ll be the technical owner of features end-to-end, from database to browser, with a focus on performance, scalability, and long-term maintainability. This role is ideal for someone who thinks in systems, thrives in ambiguity, and communicates clearly.


Requirements

- Strong expertise in Ruby on Rails at production scale;

- Proven AWS infrastructure experience (systems that don’t wake you up at night);

- Solid skills with React/Redux for full feature delivery;

- Deep understanding of PostgreSQL and performance optimization;

- Experience integrating AI tools into development workflow;

- Strong communication and ownership mindset;

- Work with EST timezone.


Responsibilities

- Own full-stack features from database to browser;

- Optimize data layers to eliminate performance bottlenecks;

- Improve Rails architecture for long-term maintainability;

- Build scalable AWS-based data pipelines;

- Deliver high-quality, production-ready React/Redux features;

- Use AI tools (e.g. Claude Code, Jules, Factory) as part of your daily development workflow;

- Communicate clearly and work independently in a high-ambiguity environment.


Would be a plus

- Experience modernizing legacy Rails systems

- Familiarity with system design and long-term infrastructure planning

- Track record of optimizing query plans and execution times

- Ability to think in terms of systems, not isolated features


Work conditions

- Opportunities to work on diverse and challenging projects;

- A supportive and collaborative team environment.

- 12 vacation days per year;

- 5 sick days per year;

- Access to therapist and psychologist support for mental well-being.

title: Engenheiro de Dados Sênior (Databricks & Power BI)
description:
Modelo de contratação: PJ (sem benefícios)

Trabalho: Remoto

⏱ Dedicação: Fulltime


Buscamos um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior com forte visão de negócio e arquitetura, capaz de atuar de ponta a ponta na cadeia de dados: desde a ingestão, processamento e orquestração de grandes volumes até a entrega de valor na camada de visualização. Você será responsável por garantir a escalabilidade, performance e governança do nosso ambiente analítico.

O que você vai fazer no dia a dia:

• Databricks & Azure: Desenvolver e otimizar pipelines escaláveis de ETL/ELT utilizando PySpark, Spark SQL e Delta Lake dentro do ecossistema Azure.

• Orquestração de Processos: Criar, manter e monitorar DAGs complexas no Apache Airflow, garantindo fluxos de trabalho eficientes, tolerantes a falhas e executados no tempo correto.

• Data Visualization & BI: Atuar como referência técnica em Power BI, desenvolvendo modelos dimensionais avançados, otimizando performance de relatórios e dominando a fundo DAX e Linguagem M (Power Query).

• Arquitetura e Governança: Estruturar, manter e otimizar o Data Lake / Data Warehouse, estabelecendo padrões rigorosos de integridade e governança de dados no Power BI e nos ambientes Cloud.

• Otimização e SQL: Elaborar e tunar consultas SQL/Spark SQL avançadas para consumo de dados e análises de performance.

• Visão de Negócio: Traduzir dores e necessidades das áreas de negócios em soluções de dados, aplicando conceitos de melhoria contínua na engenharia e no monitoramento de KPIs.

Requisitos Obrigatórios (Hard Skills):

• Sólida experiência em Databricks (desenvolvimento de rotinas em PySpark, gestão de clusters e arquitetura Medallion/Delta Lake).

• Forte conhecimento no ecossistema Microsoft Azure (integração entre serviços, Data Factory, Gen2, segurança).

• Domínio em Apache Airflow para orquestração de dados.

• Nível Especialista em Power BI , com conhecimento profundo em DAX, M e governança do Power BI Service.

• Proficiência em Python e SQL Avançado.

Diferenciais que farão você se destacar:

• Experiência prévia com migrações entre nuvens (ex: AWS Athena/Glue para Azure/Databricks).

• Familiaridade com Integração Contínua/Entrega Contínua (CI/CD) para dados no Azure DevOps.

title: SEO/Copywriter
description:
Company Overview

We are a fast-growing digital marketing agency working with U.S.-based brands, primarily in specialized industries such as boating. Our work spans paid advertising, email marketing, blog content, and multi-channel campaigns. We produce a high volume of public-facing content that must be accurate, on-brand, and technically correct.


Hours : Part-time. 10-15 hours a week


Responsibilities

  • Write, edit, and proofread marketing content across:
  • Email campaigns and nurture sequences
  • Blog articles and website content
  • Paid advertising copy (Meta, search, etc.)
  • Newsletters and press-style content
  • Collaborate closely with the founder in an iterative editorial workflow (write → edit → refine → publish)
  • Ensure all content is:
  • Factually accurate and technically correct
  • Aligned with brand voice and guidelines
  • Free of grammatical and contextual errors
  • Verify details such as product specifications, imagery alignment, and brand standards
  • Assist in developing new content (e.g., full email nurture sequences)
  • Work within marketing platforms (e.g., GoHighLevel or similar tools) to locate and update content
  • Learn and adapt to industry-specific knowledge over time
  • Potentially communicate with clients for revisions and feedback (future growth path)


Qualifications

  • Strong experience in copywriting and editing (advertising, email, blog, or digital content)
  • Excellent written English with high attention to detail
  • Ability to catch technical inaccuracies and inconsistencies
  • Experience working with brand voice guidelines
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Comfortable working in a high-volume content environment
  • Willingness to learn new industries and adapt quickly


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with marketing tools such as GoHighLevel, Mailchimp, or similar
  • Familiarity with U.S.-based brands and audiences
  • Experience in digital marketing agencies
  • Ability to both write original content and edit others’ work
  • Basic understanding of AI tools for content support

title: Supply Chain Analyst
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to join our team and help drive our growth. As a Supply Chain Analyst, you will play a critical and active role in the day-to-day operations. This is an excellent opportunity to be one of the key members of our team and position yourself for unique career growth opportunities.


Key responsibilities:


- Determine supply needs for products and services and research potential suppliers.

- Act as a link and communicate pricing and performance needs to vendors and suppliers.

- Participate in negotiations of favorable procurement contracts and prices with selected vendors and suppliers.

- Select the most suitable suppliers in terms of reliability, product quality, and cost-efficiency.

- Maintain and update a list of suppliers and their qualifications, delivery times, and potential future development.

- Prepare cost-benefit analysis reports for review by managers.


Requirements:


- 2+ years of experience in a supply management role or related position.

- Knowledge of SAP or SAP B1.

- Degree in supply chain management, logistics, business management, or related fields.

- Experience in managing inventory.

- Proficiency in SQL analysis tools and mathematical analysis.

- Interpersonal skills and ability to build and improve trust.

- Advanced level of English.


Benefits:

- Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

- Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

- Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

- Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

- Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

- Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

- Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

- Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Motion Graphics Video Editor
description:
Join Manukora, the #1 D2C Manuka Business in the USA.

Are you someone who thrives on taking charge, driving results, and staying steps ahead? Do you excel in fast-paced settings and possess an intuitive ability to understand and fulfill the needs of a dynamic team? If this resonates with you, an exciting opportunity awaits!


We’re looking for a creative, data-savvy, and proactive Video Editor to craft high-performing social media content for our fast-growing brand. This role is fully remote, with preference for some overlap with PST working hours. You’ll be at the heart of Manukora’s storytelling engine — transforming briefs into thumb-stopping, results-driven content for multiple social platforms.


This is a high-trust, high-autonomy position suited for someone who’s self-directed, obsessed with craft, and energized by creative momentum.


What You’ll Do

  • Create compelling, high-performance social media ads that align with creative briefs and drive measurable results
  • Design dynamic motion graphics, text animations, and visual effects that enhance storytelling and brand messaging
  • Collaborate closely with strategists, creative leads, and editors to optimize video and graphics content tailored for social platforms
  • Apply performance insights and creative feedback to continually refine and elevate ad effectiveness
  • Take creative ownership of projects while remaining highly receptive to feedback and iteration
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously with strong attention to detail, ensuring deadlines and quality standards are consistently met
  • Maintain organized and efficient Adobe project files


What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of professional experience creating engaging digital content for social media platforms
  • Expert-level Adobe Premiere Pro skills with a strong foundation in storytelling and pacing
  • Intermediate+ Adobe After Effects proficiency (motion graphics, kinetic typography, and visual effects)
  • Deep understanding of social media optimization and platform-specific best practices
  • Excellent English communication skills (written & verbal) for effective collaboration with international teams
  • Quick learner who thrives on feedback, adapts rapidly to new challenges, and takes ownership of creative work
  • Proven ability to work independently in a fast-paced, results-driven environment


Bonus Points For

  • Experience with AI-powered creative tools (Midjourney, RunwayML, Adobe Firefly, etc.)
  • Digital advertising agency or performance marketing experience
  • Proven track record optimizing video content for social media algorithms
  • Experience with Adobe Creative Cloud Libraries and collaborative workflows
  • Background in data-driven creative optimization


Details

  • Role Type: Full-time, Remote
  • Location: Open — at least partial overlap with PST preferred
  • Start Date: ASAP


How to Apply

Send us an email at with:

  • A few lines about what excites you about this role
  • Your resume
  • A link to your portfolio showcasing your best work


Email Only: Please note, we’re all about direct connections. Make sure to send your application via email.

title: Motion Graphics Video Editor
description:
Join Manukora, the #1 D2C Manuka Business in the USA.

Are you someone who thrives on taking charge, driving results, and staying steps ahead? Do you excel in fast-paced settings and possess an intuitive ability to understand and fulfill the needs of a dynamic team? If this resonates with you, an exciting opportunity awaits!


We’re looking for a creative, data-savvy, and proactive Video Editor to craft high-performing social media content for our fast-growing brand. This role is fully remote, with preference for some overlap with PST working hours. You’ll be at the heart of Manukora’s storytelling engine — transforming briefs into thumb-stopping, results-driven content for multiple social platforms.


This is a high-trust, high-autonomy position suited for someone who’s self-directed, obsessed with craft, and energized by creative momentum.


What You’ll Do

  • Create compelling, high-performance social media ads that align with creative briefs and drive measurable results
  • Design dynamic motion graphics, text animations, and visual effects that enhance storytelling and brand messaging
  • Collaborate closely with strategists, creative leads, and editors to optimize video and graphics content tailored for social platforms
  • Apply performance insights and creative feedback to continually refine and elevate ad effectiveness
  • Take creative ownership of projects while remaining highly receptive to feedback and iteration
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously with strong attention to detail, ensuring deadlines and quality standards are consistently met
  • Maintain organized and efficient Adobe project files


What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of professional experience creating engaging digital content for social media platforms
  • Expert-level Adobe Premiere Pro skills with a strong foundation in storytelling and pacing
  • Intermediate+ Adobe After Effects proficiency (motion graphics, kinetic typography, and visual effects)
  • Deep understanding of social media optimization and platform-specific best practices
  • Excellent English communication skills (written & verbal) for effective collaboration with international teams
  • Quick learner who thrives on feedback, adapts rapidly to new challenges, and takes ownership of creative work
  • Proven ability to work independently in a fast-paced, results-driven environment


Bonus Points For

  • Experience with AI-powered creative tools (Midjourney, RunwayML, Adobe Firefly, etc.)
  • Digital advertising agency or performance marketing experience
  • Proven track record optimizing video content for social media algorithms
  • Experience with Adobe Creative Cloud Libraries and collaborative workflows
  • Background in data-driven creative optimization


Details

  • Role Type: Full-time, Remote
  • Location: Open — at least partial overlap with PST preferred
  • Start Date: ASAP


How to Apply

Send us an email at with:

  • A few lines about what excites you about this role

  • A link to your portfolio showcasing your best work

title: Data Analyst
description:
You will be working for a US-based technology company with the leading Software, Web and mobile app development for business in North America helping independent retailers adopt and embrace this new key component of their digital marketing solution. We build and maintain thousands of retailer websites that must run reliably, efficiently, and effectively.

We are seeking a highly skilled Technical Analyst to support our data management and analytics initiatives. This role requires strong expertise in data quality, data analysis, and data governance, with hands-on experience using Metaplane for data observability. The ideal candidate will also bring capabilities in data lineage, business glossary management, and data stewardship to ensure data integrity, usability, and compliance across the organization.


The Responsibilities

  • Implement and monitor data quality frameworks and rules using Metaplane
  • Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve data anomalies and pipeline issues
  • Define and track data quality metrics and KPIs
  • Analyze large datasets to identify trends, inconsistencies, and insights
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business requirements into data solutions
  • Support reporting and analytics initiatives with accurate and reliable data
  • Document and maintain end-to-end data lineage across systems
  • Ensure traceability of data from source to consumption
  • Support impact analysis for data changes
  • Ensure consistent use of data terms across the organization
  • Partner with business and technical teams to align terminology
  • Act as a data steward for assigned domains
  • Enforce data governance policies, standards, and best practices
  • Support data ownership, and lifecycle management


Requirements

  • Proven experience as a Technical Analyst, Data Analyst, or similar role
  • Hands-on experience with Metaplane (required)
  • Strong knowledge of:
  • Experienced in Data Quality frameworks and tools
  • Strong experience in Data Analysis techniques and tools (SQL, Python, etc.)
  • Experience in Data Lineage concepts and tools
  • Business Glossary and metadata management
  • Data Governance and Data Stewardship practices
  • Experience working with modern data platforms (e.g., GCP, BigQuery)
  • Strong SQL skills and experience querying large datasets
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills
  • Strong English communication skills

description:

title: Forensic Manager
description:
This leading multinational group, with significant operations across the Americas and worldwide, is seeking an experienced Forensic Manager to lead a team of corporate investigators across their regional operations.


Based in Belo Horizonte, you will be responsible for managing a team of forensic specialists who are overseeing investigations into complex financial crimes, including conflict-of-interest, procurement fraud, misappropriation of assets, corruption, and bribery.


Your role will be primarily focused on team leadership, setting key performance objectives, and building strategic relationships to ensure seamless regional operations. You will have day-to-day responsibility for managing forensic specialists, providing career development guidance, and overseeing resource allocation. Furthermore, you will serve as the primary point of contact for operational management while playing a key role in the overall strategic management of the group’s investigative objectives.


In addition to your leadership duties, you will undertake high-level corporate investigation projects, conduct fraud awareness training, and oversee the integration of data analytics into investigative workflows.


To be successful in this role, you should possess extensive experience in leading complex corporate investigations and managing specialized forensic teams. You are likely currently working in a managerial capacity within a forensic advisory firm or a comparable corporate business.


While a CFE qualification is highly welcomed, we value your proven ability to lead high-performance teams and manage senior stakeholder relationships. Excellent communication skills are essential, and candidates must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. Proficiency in Spanish and experience with advanced data analytics tools are welcomed.


For more information, please see our video

title: Analista Digital Analytics - Junior | Varejo
description:
Descrição da vaga

A FCamara está em busca de uma Pessoa com perfil de Digital Analytics Junior, para apoiar a construção e evolução de mapeamento de coleta de dados WEB e APP, implementação e manutenção de tags de parceiros de Mídia e CRM no GTM, além ajudar em investigações e análises no dia a dia na interface do GA4 e em dados brutos, em parceria com uma das maiores empresas de solução digital, voltada ao E-commerce que tem atuação em mais de 60 anos de história, com mais de 1.000 lojas físicas, 28 centros de distribuição e mais de 33 milhões de produtos no marketplace.

Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Apoiar a execução e documentação de mapas de coleta (GA4 / Mixpanel)
  • Ajudar na implementação e validação de eventos via GTM
  • Apoiar análises simples de funil, conversão e comportamento no e-commerce
  • Trabalhar junto com times de Marketing, Produto e Growth


Requisitos e qualificações

Skills Essenciais:

  • Ser proativo, receptivo e esforçado;
  • Ser organizado para lidar com entregas;
  • Conhecimento básico em GA4 e/ou Mixpanel
  • Noções de Google Tag Manager

title: SDR / Pré vendas
description:
Descrição da Vaga – SDR (Social Seller / Pré-vendas)

Estamos em busca de um SDR (Social Seller / Pré-vendas) para atuar na linha de frente da geração e qualificação de leads para uma consultoria fitness (treino e dieta) .

Esse profissional será peça-chave no crescimento da operação, sendo responsável por iniciar conversas estratégicas com potenciais clientes, entender o momento de cada lead e conduzi-lo até o agendamento com o closer , garantindo volume e qualidade no funil de vendas.

Principais responsabilidades
  • Realizar prospecção ativa através de redes sociais (principalmente Instagram) e WhatsApp

  • Iniciar conversas com leads inbound e outbound de forma natural e estratégica

  • Identificar dores, objetivos e nível de interesse do lead

  • Qualificar leads com base em perfil e potencial de compra

  • Conduzir o lead até o agendamento da reunião com o closer

  • Executar follow-ups consistentes com leads que não responderam ou não avançaram

  • Atualizar CRM e manter organização completa das conversas e status dos leads

  • Trabalhar com metas diárias e semanais de contatos, respostas e agendamentos

    • O que buscamos
    • Boa comunicação escrita e capacidade de gerar conexão rapidamente

    • Perfil proativo, com energia para lidar com volume alto de contatos diariamente

    • Organização e disciplina para execução de follow-ups e rotina comercial

    • Foco em metas, números e melhoria contínua de performance

    • Capacidade de lidar com objeções simples e manter o lead engajado

    • Familiaridade com redes sociais (Instagram, WhatsApp)

    • Interesse ou vivência no mercado fitness (diferencial relevante) - OBRIGATÓRIO


    • Modelo de trabalho
    • Atuação 100% remota

    • Contato direto com leads via WhatsApp e redes sociais

    • Rotina estruturada com metas claras de performance (volume, taxa de resposta e agendamentos)

    • Trabalho em conjunto com o time comercial (closer), garantindo fluidez no processo de vendas

    • Acompanhamento de métricas e evolução individual

    • Oportunidade
    • Ambiente de alta performance, com foco em resultado e crescimento

    • Possibilidade real de crescimento dentro do time comercial (SDR → Closer)

    • Desenvolvimento prático em vendas, comunicação e negociação

    • Contato direto com o mercado fitness e vendas digitais

    • Remuneração com potencial de crescimento conforme performance

  • Fornecer orientação técnica e suporte para solução de problemas durante toda a execução do projeto;

  • Atuar como consultor de confiança para os clientes sobre tendências do setor e tecnologias emergentes em IA;
  • Compartilhar conhecimento dentro da organização por meio de mentoria, treinamento e criação de artefatos reutilizáveis.

Requisitos :

  • Bacharelado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia ou área relacionada, ou combinação equivalente de formação acadêmica e experiência prática;
  • Experiência relevante no desenvolvimento e implantação de modelos e/ou sistemas de aprendizado de máquina ou aprendizado profundo em larga escala em produção, incluindo processamento de dados em lote e em tempo real;
  • Processamento de dados em lote e em tempo real;
  • Conhecimento prático de IA generativa e experiência prática em engenharia de ponta, implantação e hospedagem de Modelos Fundamentais de Grande Porte;
  • Experiência com serviços de IA da AWS, como SageMaker, Bedrock e outros serviços de ML;

Estamos em busca de um Consultor Desenvolvedor ABAP com experiência em Desenvolvimento e Depuração para integrar nossa equipe de AMS. Atendo diversos clientes de diversos setores, inclusive para atendimento de clientes internacionais.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Conhecimento avançado em Depuração objetos Standards e Desenvolvidos - Desenvolver e manter programas complexos em ABAP para atender às necessidades dos clientes.
  • Realizar análise de requisitos e documentação técnica detalhada.
  • Colaborar com equipes funcionais e outros desenvolvedores para transformar requisitos de negócios em soluções técnicas.
  • Garantir a conformidade com as melhores práticas de desenvolvimento SAP e padrões de qualidade.
  • Fornecer suporte técnico avançado e resolução de problemas relacionados às soluções desenvolvidas.
  • Atuar como mentor e líder técnico para desenvolvedores de nível júnior e pleno.
  • Participar ativamente em projetos de implementação e atualização de sistemas SAP.

Requisitos:

  • Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento ABAP.
  • Conhecimento em formulários (AdobeForm, Smartforms e SapScript )
  • Conhecimento e experiência em SAP Fiori, incluindo SAPUI5 e OData.
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento e manutenção de workflows SAP.
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de relatórios, interfaces, conversões, melhoramentos e formulários
  • Capacidade de entender e traduzir especificações funcionais complexas em soluções técnicas eficazes.
  • Habilidades analíticas e de resolução de problemas de alta complexidade.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente e liderar equipes técnicas.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal.

Diferenciais:

  • Certificações SAP relevantes.
  • Experiência em projetos de implementação SAP S/4HANA.
  • Conhecimentos em outras tecnologias SAP como SAP Gateway, AMDPs, BTP, Webdympro.
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Participação em projetos internacionais ou ambientes multiculturais.


Vaga remota (apenas residentes no Brasil)

Regime de Contratação: CLT

Somos a maior empresa de consultoria SAP do mundo para empresas de médio porte. Torne-se um especialista trabalhando em grandes projetos. Com as parcerias SAP Platinum, Microsoft e AWS, impulsionamos a inovação e adotamos novas tecnologias. Com a nossa visão e ambição, entregamos desempenho de alta performance.

title: Implementation Analyst
description:
Job Title: Implementation Analyst


English Resume Only


Location: Brazil

Type: Full-Time Contract

Setup: Fully Remote

Level: Mid-Level

Industry: Software SAAS Company

Shift: US Hours

Start Date: can start in 2 weeks after offer

Equipment: Available upon request

Rate: R$8,000 - R$10,000


About The Methodical Group

The Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as ExactTalent®, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge.


About the Opportunity

Our client is seeking an Implementation Analyst to support their Professional Services team, leading end-to-end deployments of a SaaS platform across municipal government clients. This role combines project leadership, client engagement, and product expertise—guiding customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful system adoption.

The Implementation Analyst will work closely with clients to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable system solutions, ensuring each customer realizes measurable value while delivering a seamless and high-quality onboarding experience.


Responsibilities

  • Lead the full implementation lifecycle for new customers, from kickoff through go-live, managing multiple concurrent implementations for small-to-mid-sized municipal clients.
  • Conduct discovery sessions to gather business requirements, workflows, and success metrics, translating them into system configurations.
  • Configure and customize the SaaS platform based on client-specific use cases while maintaining best practices and scalability.
  • Coordinate with Data Engineers on data imports and integrations, performing QA testing to validate functionality and data integrity prior to go-live.
  • Deliver customer training sessions to ensure user adoption and proficiency across departments.
  • Monitor project timelines, proactively managing scope, risks, dependencies, and overall project health.
  • Document configurations, implementation decisions, and knowledge base materials to support consistency and scalability.
  • Collaborate with Product, Support, and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth transition and ongoing client success post-launch.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and recommend best practices to optimize future implementations.


Qualifications

  • At least 2 years of Professional Services or Implementation experience supporting Enterprise SaaS products.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS platforms, cloud environments, and data management principles.
  • Working knowledge of data concepts such as file formats, field mapping, and data validation, with the ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams.
  • Experience using tools such as Wrike, HubSpot, Salesforce, Jira, or similar implementation and project tracking platforms.
  • Proven experience working directly with clients and managing multiple implementation projects simultaneously.
  • Ability to manage client relationships professionally, set expectations, and communicate effectively throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Strong ability to translate technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language.
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, organizational, and time-management skills.
  • Ability to quickly learn new technologies, tools, and business domains.

title: Java Developer
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Java Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Work with software development teams to gather requirements and ensure best practices are adhered.

- Design, Implement & Support solutions for application development, security, analytics and performance management.

- Conform to existing industry security coding standards adhering to fortify scan and other security tool review requirements.

- Conduct code reviews for junior members of the team and do peer code reviews to make sure code is following standards set forward by the architects.

- Run test scripts against code to ensure quality delivery.

- Resolve code issues with urgency.


Requirements:


- 5+ years of experience in Java.

- Experience in web application programming.

- Knowledge of Object Oriented Programming.

- Ability to work with relational and non-relational bases.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

- Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

- Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

- Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

- Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

- Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

- Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

- Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

- Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Executivo de Vendas
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional com perfil técnico-comercial para atuar como Executivo de Vendas em um segmento industrial altamente especializado, focado em soluções de detecção e separação de metais em processos produtivos.


Se você gosta de desafios, tem perfil consultivo e quer atuar diretamente no campo, contribuindo com soluções técnicas que geram impacto real nos clientes, essa oportunidade é para você.


Sobre a posição

Você será responsável por conduzir todo o processo comercial, desde a prospecção até o fechamento, com forte atuação em campo. Além disso, terá papel fundamental na demonstração prática de equipamentos, suporte técnico e desenvolvimento de soluções personalizadas para clientes industriais.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Realizar prospecção ativa e visitas a clientes em diferentes regiões;
  • Conduzir apresentações técnicas e demonstrações de equipamentos em campo;
  • Levantar necessidades e desenvolver propostas comerciais alinhadas ao cliente;
  • Gerenciar o ciclo completo de vendas (prospecção, negociação e fechamento);
  • Expandir e desenvolver a carteira de clientes;
  • Acompanhar tendências de mercado e atuação da concorrência;
  • Elaborar relatórios comerciais e acompanhar indicadores de desempenho;
  • Atuar de forma integrada com áreas internas e parceiros comerciais;
  • Apoiar testes, treinamentos e implementação de soluções junto aos clientes.


O que buscamos:

  • Formação superior em Engenharia (Controle e Automação, Elétrica, Mecânica, Produção) ou cursos técnicos correlatos (Mecatrônica, Elétrica, Automação);
  • Experiência em vendas externas no segmento industrial;
  • Vivência com automação, instrumentação ou processos produtivos será um diferencial;
  • Conhecimento em ambientes industriais e linhas produtivas;
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes.


Perfil desejado:

  • Proatividade e autonomia;
  • Forte orientação para resultados;
  • Perfil consultivo e boa comunicação;
  • Organização e disciplina na gestão de atividades comerciais;
  • Capacidade analítica para entender problemas e propor soluções;
  • Postura colaborativa e senso de responsabilidade.


Modelo de trabalho

Atuação majoritariamente em campo, com base em home office e disponibilidade para viagens.

title: Lead Crypto Research Analyst
description:
About Ideal Concept Holding (ICH)

Ideal Concept Holding is a diversified investment group with a robust portfolio spanning retail, construction, real estate, and general trading across the UAE, Turkey, Azerbaijan, and Georgia. As we expand our global footprint, we are integrating digital asset strategies to optimize treasury management, explore tokenization of real-world assets (RWA), and identify high-potential Web3 investment opportunities. We combine traditional business stability with forward-looking technological innovation.


Role Overview

We are seeking a highly analytical and strategic Lead Crypto Research Analyst to head our digital assets research initiative. Based remotely in Brazil, you will serve as the primary intelligence source for the executive team, identifying emerging trends, evaluating early-stage Web3 projects, and providing data-driven recommendations for capital allocation.

This is not a trading role. It is a fundamental research position focused on due diligence, risk assessment, and strategic advisory. You will help ICH navigate the complex landscape of blockchain technology, ensuring that our exposure to digital assets is compliant, secure, and aligned with long-term corporate goals.


Key Responsibilities

  • Fundamental Research & Due Diligence: Conduct deep-dive analysis of Web3 sectors (DeFi, Infrastructure, RWA, Layer 2s, Gaming). Evaluate projects based on technology, team credibility, tokenomics, and market fit.
  • Investment Thesis Development: Create and maintain actionable investment theses for the CIO and Board. Identify undervalued opportunities and potential risks in the crypto market.
  • On-Chain Analytics: Utilize tools like Dune Analytics, Nansen, Etherscan, and DefiLlama to verify project metrics, track user growth, monitor whale activity, and assess network health.
  • Tokenomics Modeling: Analyze token distribution models, vesting schedules, inflation rates, and utility mechanisms to identify sustainable projects vs. speculative pumps.
  • Executive Reporting: Prepare concise, high-impact investment memorandums and weekly market intelligence briefings for senior leadership.
  • Regulatory & Risk Monitoring: Stay updated on global regulatory developments (including Brazil’s CVM guidelines, MiCA in EU, and VARA in UAE) and assess their impact on ICH’s strategy.
  • Portfolio Support: Monitor existing digital asset holdings or pilot projects, providing regular performance reports and rebalancing recommendations.


Qualifications

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in financial research, equity analysis, or venture capital, with at least 2–3 years specifically focused on Crypto/Web3 assets.
  • Technical Depth: Strong understanding of blockchain fundamentals (consensus mechanisms, smart contracts, DeFi primitives, ZK-proofs). Ability to read technical whitepapers and audit reports.
  • Analytical Skills: Proficiency in financial modeling (Excel/Google Sheets) and on-chain data analysis tools (Dune, Nansen, Arkham, Glassnode). SQL or Python skills are a strong plus.
  • Market Knowledge: Deep familiarity with the global crypto landscape, including key players, narratives (e.g., RWA, AI x Crypto), and market cycles.
  • Communication: Exceptional written English for reporting to international executives. Portuguese is native/preferred for local coordination.
  • Integrity: High ethical standards and attention to detail. You are skeptical by nature and rely on data, not hype.


Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive Salary: $105,000 - $150,000 USD per year (adjusted for experience and location).
  • Performance Bonus: Annual bonus tied to the accuracy of research insights and successful identification of opportunities.
  • Flexible Payment: Option to receive a portion of compensation in Stablecoins (USDC/USDT) or Fiat (BRL/USD), compliant with local laws.
  • Professional Growth: Budget for premium research tools (Messari, Token Terminal) and industry conferences.

title: Sr Data & Analytics Engineer \"#999885\"
description:
Quem Somos

“A DEXIAN é uma consultoria global de origem Americana focada em talentos para complementar a equipe de tecnologia da informação de nossos clientes. Estamos presente em 10 países, com 45 escritórios ao redor do mundo. Por mais de 25 anos, a DEXIAN® atende indústrias e clientes globais, em diversas áreas, com a missão de atrair e reter os maiores talentos do mundo.

Hoje somos orgulhosamente reconhecidos como uma das maiores empresas de “staffing augmentation” dos Estados Unidos pela Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA). Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

No Brasil, chegamos em 2007 e de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia.


O que esperar de nós

É importante que você saiba que por trás de cada movimento DEXIAN existem cinco valores fundamentais: colaboração, respeito, justiça, comprometimento e engenhosidade. Colaboração, justiça e respeito não são apenas palavras; comprometimento não é só um pensamento; e engenhosidade vai além de aspiração. Essas qualidades nos definem em todos os níveis, todas as parcerias e na forma como trabalhamos todos os dias. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

A DEXIAN do Brasil incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.


Nosso Cliente

Essa vaga irá atender nosso cliente no segmento de engenharia de sistemas.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

Our client is looking for a Data & Analytics Engineer with a passion for data and strong analytics capabilities to help grow our business. The Data & Analytics Engineer will support profitable and sustainable sales strategies with customers and help develop advanced sales reporting and analytics capabilities for scale. This person will champion our mission to be data-driven and will possess strong interpersonal skills, robust technical and data analysis capabilities, and a natural sense of curiosity that drives them to identify trends and promote opportunities. The position is sure to develop one’s leadership, management, and analytics capabilities as well as provide an exciting career path. The role is highly visible with broad exposure to senior leaders across the business.

Key Responsibilities

· Leverage data tools to provide reporting and insights which will further develop company and retailer objectives.

· Create and maintain customer scorecards inclusive of key metrics such as volume, share, distribution, weekly sales ranks, store performance, etc.

· Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability.

· Responsible for developing and running weekly and monthly brand reports to help partnership teams understand trends.

· Ability to prioritize work and key projects based on the needs of the team and the business

· Design, build, and maintain reliable data pipelines to move and transform data from disparate sources (Excel, ERP, CRM, operational systems) into the enterprise data warehouse (Snowflake).

· Develop and manage data models (dimensional and semantic layers) that enable analysts and business users to access trusted, well-structured data for reporting.

· Collaborate with analysts and business stakeholders to translate reporting/analytics needs into scalable data solutions while documenting definitions and lineage.

· Ad-hoc requests/projects as needed.


O que você precisa ter:

· Advenced english is primordial, you'll work with an international team.

· 5+ years of experience data engineering, ETL/ELT development, or analytics engineering

· Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data engineering or related field, OR equivalent hands-on experience

· Proficient in SQL (writing, optimizing and troubleshooting complex queries)

· Understanding of database concepts such as database structures, query languages (SQL), and data warehousing principles.

· Experience working with ETL and data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, Alteryx, other).

· Proven track record of building collaborative relationships across functional areas.

· Self-starter with an ability to drive projects from initiation to completion.

· Adept at prioritizing work and key projects based on the needs of the team and the business.


Onde você vai trabalhar:

Regime remoto, qualquer lugar do Brasil.

- Experience with Typescript.

- Comfortable working in GMT+2 timezone.

- Fluent Spanish level.

- Intermediate English level.

title: Desenvolvedor
description:
Desenvolvedor(a) .NET + Python + AWS


Modalidade: remoto

Tipo de Contrato: CLT


Responsabilidades:

- Desenvolver, testar e manter aplicações em .NET e Python, garantindo a eficiência e escalabilidade dos sistemas.

- Projetar e implementar soluções em nuvem utilizando AWS, incluindo serviços como EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS e outros.

- Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para entender requisitos de negócios e traduzir em soluções técnicas eficazes.

- Participar na definição de arquiteturas de sistemas e na escolha de tecnologias apropriadas para os projetos.

- Implementar práticas de DevOps, incluindo CI/CD, automação de testes e monitoramento de aplicações.

- Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de desenvolvimento e da qualidade do código.


Requisitos:

- Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento de aplicações com .NET (C# ou VB.NET).

- Proficiência em Python e suas bibliotecas comuns.

- Conhecimento prático de serviços AWS e arquiteturas de nuvem.

- Familiaridade com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais (SQL, NoSQL).

- Experiência em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, etc.).

- Habilidade em trabalhar em equipe e excelentes habilidades de comunicação.


Diferenciais:

- Certificações em AWS ou outras tecnologias relevantes.

- Experiência em contêineres (Docker, Kubernetes).

- Conhecimento em práticas de segurança na nuvem.

title: Consultor de Vendas
description:
Necessário fluência em inglês

Tipo de Contrato: Comissionado / Prestador de Serviços (Independent Contractor)

Remuneração: Estrutura de comissões elevadas + bônus por performance. (Esta posição é mais indicada para profissionais que se sentem confortáveis com um modelo de remuneração orientado a resultados e que têm confiança na própria capacidade de gerar sucesso.)


A Bluenet Solutions é um dealer autorizado de alto desempenho da AT&T, Xfinity e outras grandes operadoras de telecomunicações dos Estados Unidos. Com sede nos EUA, somos especializados em oferecer soluções de telefonia móvel, internet e dispositivos inteligentes para comunidades de imigrantes em todo o país.

Estamos expandindo nossa atuação comercial e buscamos uma especialista em vendas baseada no Brasil para integrar nosso time remoto internacional.


O que você vai fazer:

  • Vender planos de telefonia móvel, iPhones e serviços de internet para clientes
  • Realizar atendimentos e consultorias via WhatsApp, WeChat ou telefone
  • Trabalhar com leads gerados por nossas campanhas de anúncios e landing pages
  • Acompanhar o cliente durante todo o processo de venda e auxiliar no onboarding
  • Colaborar com nossos times remotos e operações
  • Fornecer feedback para melhoria contínua das estratégias de abordagem e experiência do cliente


O que buscamos:

  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência em vendas, preferencialmente em telecom, tecnologia, seguros ou serviços internacionais
  • Fluência em inglês
  • Experiência com fechamento de vendas de alto valor ou modelos de receita recorrente
  • Forte habilidade de comunicação, follow-up e negociação
  • Conexão de internet estável e capacidade de trabalhar remotamente
  • Perfil autônomo, responsável e altamente orientado a resultados


O que você vai encontrar aqui:

  • Comissões atrativas por venda
  • Horários flexíveis – posição 100% remota
  • Oportunidade de crescimento para liderança de equipe ou parceiro regional

title: Alteryx Server Specialist - LatAm based
description:
Position Summary

Data Meaning is a front-runner in Business Intelligence and Data Analytics consulting, renowned for our high-quality consulting services throughout the US and LATAM. Our expertise lies in delivering tailored solutions in Business Intelligence, Data Warehousing, and Project Management. We are dedicated to bringing premier services to our diverse clientele. We have a global team of 95+ consultants, all working remotely, embodying a collaborative, inclusive, and innovation-driven work culture.


Position Overview

We are proactively building a pipeline of experienced Alteryx Specialists who are passionate about data analytics and business intelligence. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work on exciting projects, leveraging your expertise in Alteryx to drive data-driven decision-making across the organization.


Responsibilities:

  • Utilize Alteryx as the primary tool to design, develop, and implement data analytics workflows, ETL processes, and data integration solutions.
  • Collaborate with clients to understand their business requirements and translate them into actionable insights using Alteryx.
  • Apply additional skills, such as Power BI or other relevant tools, to enhance data visualization and reporting capabilities for client projects.
  • Communicate with clients in a professional and client-facing manner, ensuring clear understanding of requirements, project updates, and deliverables.
  • Perform data manipulation, cleansing, and transformation tasks using Alteryx and other relevant tools.
  • Develop and maintain documentation for Alteryx workflows, including workflow diagrams, data dictionaries, and user guides.
  • Conduct data quality assessments and implement data validation processes to ensure accuracy and integrity of the outputs.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate Alteryx outputs with Tableau, Power BI, or other reporting tools.
  • Stay updated with the latest industry trends and advancements in Alteryx and related technologies to continuously enhance technical skills and provide innovative solutions to clients.
  • Provide technical support and assistance to clients during the implementation and deployment of Alteryx workflows.


Qualifications:

  • Strong proficiency in Alteryx Designer, with a deep understanding of Alteryx workflows, formulas, macros, and data integration processes.
  • Proficiency with Alteryx Server
  • Additional skills in Power BI or other data visualization tools are highly preferred.
  • Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal, with the ability to interact with clients in a professional and client-facing manner.
  • Fluency in Spanish is a huge plus, enabling effective communication with clients in the LATAM market.
  • Experience in data manipulation, cleansing, and transformation using Alteryx and other relevant tools.
  • Knowledge of ETL processes and data integration techniques.
  • Proficiency in SQL and database concepts.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with great attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

Our expertise lies in delivering tailored solutions in Business Intelligence, Data Warehousing, and Project Management. We are dedicated to bringing premier services to our diverse clientele. We have a global team of 95+ consultants, all working remotely, embodying a collaborative, inclusive, and innovation-driven work culture.


Position Overview

We are proactively building a pipeline of experienced Alteryx Specialists who are passionate about data analytics and business intelligence. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work on exciting projects, leveraging your expertise in Alteryx to drive data-driven decision-making across the organization.


Responsibilities:

  • Utilize Alteryx as the primary tool to design, develop, and implement data analytics workflows, ETL processes, and data integration solutions.
  • Collaborate with clients to understand their business requirements and translate them into actionable insights using Alteryx.
  • Apply additional skills, such as Power BI or other relevant tools, to enhance data visualization and reporting capabilities for client projects.
  • Communicate with clients in a professional and client-facing manner, ensuring clear understanding of requirements, project updates, and deliverables.
  • Perform data manipulation, cleansing, and transformation tasks using Alteryx and other relevant tools.
  • Develop and maintain documentation for Alteryx workflows, including workflow diagrams, data dictionaries, and user guides.
  • Conduct data quality assessments and implement data validation processes to ensure accuracy and integrity of the outputs.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate Alteryx outputs with Tableau, Power BI, or other reporting tools.
  • Stay updated with the latest industry trends and advancements in Alteryx and related technologies to continuously enhance technical skills and provide innovative solutions to clients.
  • Provide technical support and assistance to clients during the implementation and deployment of Alteryx workflows.


Qualifications:

  • Strong proficiency in Alteryx Designer, with a deep understanding of Alteryx workflows, formulas, macros, and data integration processes.
  • Proficiency with Alteryx Server
  • Additional skills in Power BI or other data visualization tools are highly preferred.
  • Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal, with the ability to interact with clients in a professional and client-facing manner.
  • Fluency in Spanish is a huge plus, enabling effective communication with clients in the LATAM market.
  • Experience in data manipulation, cleansing, and transformation using Alteryx and other relevant tools.
  • Knowledge of ETL processes and data integration techniques.
  • Proficiency in SQL and database concepts.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with great attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

title: Diretor(a) de Arte: Conteúdo & IA Criativa
description:
Sobre a Flint:

A Flint é um selo de edutainment que transforma educação em influência e influência em negócio. Criamos programas que misturam conteúdo, comunidade e inteligência aplicada para capacitar profissionais e empresas a usarem a linguagem das redes como ferramenta estratégica. 


Nossos projetos combinam storytelling, prática e pertencimento, com formatos digitais, linguagem viva e experiências pensadas para quem aprende fazendo. Trabalhamos com grandes marcas e criadores para transformar conhecimento em impacto real, ampliando vozes, repertórios e oportunidades

Sobre a posição: 

Estamos procurando um(a) Diretor(a) de Arte com olhar contemporâneo de internet e forte autonomia criativa. Essa pessoa será responsável por transformar ideias em conceitos visuais e conteúdo nativo para redes sociais, explorando formatos visuais contemporâneos e utilizando inteligência artificial como ferramenta de criação no dia a dia, seja para geração de imagem, vídeo ou experimentação visual. 


Buscamos alguém que entenda que estética de internet não nasce só no design tradicional, mas também em cultura digital, creators, memes, formatos emergentes e novas ferramentas criativas.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver conceitos visuais e direção de arte para conteúdos digitais e campanhas sociais 
  • Criar imagens, vídeos e peças visuais utilizando ferramentas de IA generativa 
  • Traduzir ideias e narrativas em formatos visuais nativos para redes sociais 
  • Explorar novas linguagens visuais inspiradas pela creator economy e cultura de internet 
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com times de estratégia, conteúdo e comunidade 
  • Participar do desenvolvimento de narrativas visuais para social media e projetos especiais 
  • Experimentar continuamente com novas ferramentas, formatos e processos criativos baseados em IA 


Requisitos: 

  • Forte repertório visual e pensamento conceitual 
  • Experiência com direção de arte para conteúdo digital ou social media 
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de IA criativa (imagem e vídeo) 
  • Domínio de ferramentas de design e edição visual 
  • Capacidade de transformar ideias em execuções visuais rápidas e consistentes 


Diferenciais 

  • Noções de motion design e edição de vídeo 
  • Experiência criando conteúdo nativo para plataformas sociais 
  • Conhecimento de prompting e workflows criativos com IA 
  • Interesse por novas linguagens visuais da internet 


Perfil que buscamos 

  • Pessoa criativa, curiosa e com repertório cultural digital 
  • Confortável em um fluxo de criação que mistura design, cultura de internet e inteligência artificial 
  • Rápida para testar ideias e iterar 
  • Autônoma, mas colaborativa 
  • Atenta às mudanças de linguagem e estética das plataformas
